title: Resident Medical Officer
description:

**Job description:** 




**Resident Medical Officer (RMO)** 




**Calida Rehab – Mental Health \& De\-Addiction Rehabilitation Center**

**Location: Pune and Karjat, Maharashtra**

**About Calida Rehab:** 




**Calida Rehab is a leading multidisciplinary mental health and de\-addiction rehabilitation centre dedicated to providing holistic, integrated patient care. Our team includes experienced psychiatrists, psychologists, counsellors, nurses, and medical professionals committed to excellence in mental health and addiction treatment.**

**\- Support administrative functions of the centre**

**· \- Bachelor's Degree in Medicine: BHMS (Bachelor of Homeopathic Medicine) / BAMS (Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine) / MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery)**

**Experience:**

**Professional Skills:** 




**· Strong clinical assessment and diagnostic abilities** 




**· Excellent medication management and prescribing knowledge**

**· Strong communication skills – both written and verbal** 




**· Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment**

**Work Requirements:**

title: Senior Software Testing Engineer
description:
**Position:** 
 Senior Software Testing Engineer
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full Time
 



**Location:** 
 Navi Mumbai
 



**Salary:** 
 ₹3\.6 – ₹7\.2 Lakhs per annum
 



**Minimum Education:** 
 Graduate with relevant Certification
 



**Experience Required:** 
 4\+ Years in Software Testing (Minimum 2 Years in Automation Testing)
 



  





 The Adroit is hiring an experienced and career\-focused
 **Senior Software Testing Engineer (Automation) in Navi Mumbai** 
 to strengthen our quality assurance team. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in
 **automation testing, manual testing, performance testing, and API testing** 
 , with hands\-on experience using automation tools such as Selenium and SpecFlow.
 



  





 As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you will play a key role in the software development lifecycle by ensuring high\-quality product releases. You will conduct automated and manual testing, identify defects, and collaborate with development teams to deliver reliable and scalable software solutions.
 



  





**Work Profile:** 



* Perform manual and automation testing for web, mobile, and API\-based applications to ensure software quality and reliability.
* Develop, maintain, and enhance automation frameworks for web and API testing using tools such as Selenium and SpecFlow.
* Design, develop, and execute automated and manual test scripts for functional, regression, performance, stress, and scalability testing.
* Create risk\-based testing strategies to identify vulnerabilities, improve test coverage, and ensure application stability.
* Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, and project support teams for defect identification, troubleshooting, and resolution.
* Execute test cases across multiple environments including web, mobile, and cross\-browser platforms.
* Identify business requirements, analyze system specifications, and design effective testing strategies accordingly.
* Write detailed bug reports, maintain test documentation, and record test execution results accurately.
* Review technical documentation, functional requirements, and user stories to ensure complete test coverage.
* Monitor software quality standards and ensure applications meet predefined acceptance criteria before deployment.
* Participate in release planning, regression testing cycles, and deployment validation activities.
* Troubleshoot and resolve testing\-related issues while ensuring timely delivery of QA activities.
* Present testing findings, quality reports, and risk assessments to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Provide objective feedback and improvement recommendations to development and business teams.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of QA methodologies, automation frameworks, testing processes, and best practices.
* Manage multiple testing projects simultaneously while meeting departmental timelines and quality expectations.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience in Software Testing.
* Minimum 2 years of hands\-on experience in
 **Automation Testing** 
 .
* Strong knowledge of
 **Selenium, SpecFlow, and API Automation** 
 .
* Proven experience in functional, regression, and performance testing.
* Good understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and QA methodologies.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Excellent presentation and reporting abilities.
* Self\-motivated team player who can work independently with minimal supervision.

title: Principal Wealth Advisor
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**
 Industry: Financial Services
   

  

 Seniority level: Mid\-Senior level
   

  

 Experience: 5\+ yrs
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 Job Type: Full\-time
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Principal Wealth Advisor** 
 to provide comprehensive, goal\-based financial planning and wealth advisory services to high\-value clients. The role focuses on understanding each client’s financial objectives, risk profile, current financial position, and long\-term milestones to develop practical and personalised wealth strategies.
   

  

 You will work across investment planning, retirement planning, tax and estate considerations, budgeting, debt management, and long\-term wealth creation. The ideal candidate will combine strong financial planning expertise with excellent client\-management skills and the ability to translate complex financial concepts into clear, actionable advice.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

  

* Work closely with Wealth Advisors and the advisory team to deliver high\-quality financial planning and wealth advisory services
* Develop comprehensive financial plans covering investments, retirement, tax, estate planning, budgeting, debt management, and wealth creation
* Assess clients’ financial positions, including income, expenses, assets, liabilities, cash flows, and investment portfolios
* Evaluate client risk profiles, financial objectives, life goals, and key milestones when developing recommendations
* Review and validate financial planning work prepared by Wealth Advisors to ensure accuracy, quality, and alignment with client requirements
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with clients through regular communication and ongoing financial guidance
* Understand clients’ changing financial circumstances and proactively identify relevant planning opportunities
* Translate financial analysis and recommendations into clear, practical, and actionable strategies
* Develop and implement action plans based on clients’ financial objectives and agreed recommendations
* Monitor implementation of financial plans and coordinate with relevant stakeholders where required
* Support clients throughout the year and review financial plans as their circumstances, goals, or risk profiles evolve
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a consistent, high\-quality client advisory experience
* Maintain appropriate documentation and ensure financial planning recommendations are well\-supported and aligned with established advisory principles
* Stay current with developments in financial planning, investment products, taxation, retirement planning, and wealth management practices


 What Makes You a Great Fit
   

  

  

* 5\+ years of relevant experience in wealth management, financial planning, investment advisory, private wealth, or a closely related client\-facing financial role
* Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA from a leading business school is mandatory
* Additionally, one of the following qualifications is required or strongly preferred:
+ CFP (Certified Financial Planner) or CWM (Chartered Wealth Manager); or
+ CFA Level II cleared or CFA Level III candidate

* Strong understanding of comprehensive financial planning and wealth management principles
* Experience analysing investments, financial statements, cash flows, assets, liabilities, and client portfolios
* Strong understanding of risk profiling and goal\-based financial planning
* Ability to develop practical financial strategies across investments, retirement, tax, estate planning, and wealth creation
* Experience in a client\-facing wealth advisory environment with strong relationship\-management responsibilities
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, presentation, and client\-management skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to explain complex financial concepts clearly to clients and other stakeholders
* Strong collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively with Wealth Advisors and multidisciplinary advisory teams
* Self\-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable taking ownership of client outcomes and advisory responsibilities
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development
* Willingness to work full\-time from the Andheri office in Mumbai

The shift is happening: from addressing deficiencies to proactively optimizing well\-being. And we’re leading this movement with science\-backed, effortless nutrition solutions designed for modern lifestyles. We’re not just a brand; we’re a revolution in how nutrition fits seamlessly into daily life making better health accessible, achievable, and sustainable for everyone.
 





 If you’re passionate about innovation, impact, and transforming lives, join us in shaping the future of nutrition!
 





 \#TruNativ \#FuelBetter \#JoinTheMovement \#NowHiring
 




  






 Trunativ has been recently backed by Emami Limited \& Mr. Nithin Kamath \- Zerodha Rainmatter.
 




  




* Know more about us:
 
 http://www.trunativ.co



  






 Role:
 
**Accounts Receivable Manager (D2C)** 






 Department:
 
**Finance** 





 Location:
 
**Andheri, Lower Oshiwara (100% Work from Office)** 





 Reports to:
 
**Finance Manager** 




  





**Job Summary**




 We are seeking an analytically\-minded and detail\-oriented Accounts Receivable Manager to lead our D2C and e\-commerce revenue accounting operations. In this role, you will manage a team focused on matching high\-volume transactional data against payment gateway disbursements, monitoring multi\-channel cash flow, and resolving settlement discrepancies. You will bridge the gap between financial oversight and daily digital operations to ensure flawless revenue recognition and tight working capital control.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





**1\- E\-commerce \& Marketplace Reconciliation** 




 •
 **Reconcile payment gateways** 
 (e.g., Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal) to track incoming consumer checkouts against actual bank deposits.
 



 •
 **Audit marketplace settlements** 
 (e.g., Amazon, Flipkart) against internal sales registers, accounting for commission fees, logistics costs, and marketplace deductions.
 



 •
 **Manage Cash\-on\-Delivery (COD)** 
 pipelines by tracking and reconciling courier partner collections and aging reports.
 



 •
 **Oversee automated system data matching** 
 between storefront applications (e.g., Shopify), internal ERP systems, and bank transactions.
 



  





**2\- Returns, Refunds, \& Dispute Management** 




 •
 **Verify consumer refunds and processing fees** 
 against return shipping receipts and item restock logs.
 



 •
 **Investigate chargeback disputes** 
 issued by credit card networks or payment processors to minimize fraud losses.
 



 •
 **Reconcile inventory adjustments** 
 relating to lost\-in\-transit orders or reverse logistics returns in tandem with the supply chain team.
 



  





**3\- Cash Flow Monitoring \& Financial Control** 




 •
 **Track the Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)** 
 metrics and create real\-time collection dashboards for leadership.
 



 •
 **Enforce internal financial control SOPs** 
 for physical point\-of\-sale (POS) retail locations if Omni\-channel structures apply.
 



 •
 **Manage corporate client lines if the D2C** 
 brand sells via bulk corporate gifting or wholesale distribution agreements.
 



  





**4\- Compliance, Taxation, \& Reporting** 




 •
 **Ensure accurate revenue recognition standards** 
 are maintained across varying promotional models, discount structures, and gift card redemptions.
 



 •
 **Format outward supply data** 
 to cleanly align with multi\-state tax frameworks (like Indian GST or state\-level sales taxes).
 



 •
 **Support month\-end closing timelines** 
 and deliver ledger transparency for upcoming statutory and internal audits.
 



  





**5\- Team Leadership \& Process Automation** 




 •
 **Direct and mentor** 
 a dedicated team of junior AR analysts and billing coordinators.
 



 •
 **Drive systems engineering to automate** 
 manual data pulling or heavy Excel\-based reconciliation loops.
 



  





**Skills \& Qualifications**




  





**Education \& Experience** 




 • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.
 



 • Industry Experience: 6 to 7\+ years of dedicated revenue tracking or AR experience specifically within an e\-commerce, D2C, retail, or FMCG brand.
 



 • Leadership Experience: Minimum 1–2 years supervising financial or accounting workflows.
 



  





**Technical Skills** 




 • Advanced data manipulation capabilities in Microsoft Excel (e.g., Power Query, Pivot Tables, massive data\-array matching).
 



 • Deep functional hands\-on experience using modern ERP software
 



 • Familiarity with the backend financial portals of storefront ecosystems like Shopify or Amazon Seller Central.
 



  





**Soft Skills** 




 • Exceptionally sharp analytical and forensic data investigation skills.
 



 • Comfortable interfacing across multi\-disciplinary functions (logistics, marketing, and web tech teams) to isolate payment errors.
 



  





**Immediate joiners or candidates serving their notice period are preferred.**

* Provide clear and concise explanations to clients regarding performance issues and solutions.
* Collaborate with client teams to implement performance improvements as necessary.

* Develop and present case studies, whitepapers, presentation, IP creation, Client Demo’s etc

 Deliver high\-impact virtual leadership and communication training for employees of a US\-based logistics company. This is a delivery\-focused learning partner role, not an end\-to\-end course builder. The ideal candidate will:

* Conduct comprehensive needs analysis and drive continuous improvement measurement

Talent Development involves creating and implementing programs to enhance employees skills and career growth. This includes training, mentoring, and performance management. The goal is to help employees reach their full potential and contribute effectively to the organization. Responsibilities also include identifying skill gaps and developing strategies to address them. This role is essential for fostering a skilled and motivated workforce. Ensure successful delivery of learning solutions and review their effectiveness and applicability. What are we looking for?
* 5\-10 years of proven experience delivering leadership and communication training, preferably with US client exposure and scalable virtual delivery models.

* Multiple LDP certifications (e.g., MBTI \+ Hogan \+ CliftonStrengths combination) demonstrating depth of expertise.
* Experience with logistics\-specific leadership challenges, frontline team motivation, operational decision\-making, and supply chain context.
* Expertise in adaptive, blended, and personalized learning models; experience with learning technology and adaptive platforms.
* Track record of scaling training programs from pilot to enterprise level; experience managing multiple concurrent cohorts.
* Speaking experience at industry conferences, webinars, or training forums.
* Background in organizational development, change management, or executive coaching. 1\. Needs Analysis \& Discovery \- Ability to conduct structured interviews, design assessment frameworks, analyze organizational contexts, and translate insights into delivery design. 2\. Persona Development \& Adaptation \- Skill in creating learner personas, adapting communication style, and customizing examples and activities based on audience profiles. 3\. Measurement \& Data Analysis \- Comfort with training metrics, survey design, data interpretation, and translating findings into recommendations. 4\. Continuous Improvement Mindset \- Proactive approach to identifying enhancement opportunities, iterating on delivery, and documenting learnings for scaling. 5\. Customer Liaison \& Stakeholder Management \- Comfort presenting to C\-suite, gathering feedback, managing expectations, and building collaborative partnerships. 6\. Virtual Facilitation Excellence \- Mastery of virtual delivery techniques, participant engagement in distributed settings, time zone flexibility, and technical proficiency. 7\. LDP Framework Expertise \- Deep knowledge of behavioral, personality, or emotional intelligence assessment models; ability to integrate frameworks into training design and coaching. Roles and Responsibilities:
* Training Delivery \& Content Customization

**Company Description** 




 Flood Precast, established in 1979, specializes in precast concrete products with a strong focus on precast concrete structures. Through continuous research and development, the company has expanded its capabilities and product range to serve diverse construction needs. Flood Flooring is now recognised as the largest producer of precast concrete flooring in the UK and Irish markets. The company is committed to quality, innovation, and reliable delivery, offering robust engineering solutions to support modern infrastructure projects.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Senior Tekla Modeler \& Detailer role at Flood Precast India is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Mumbai. The role involves creating and managing detailed 3D models of precast concrete Structures using Tekla Structures, including Solid walls, Twin walls, floors, beams, columns, and associated connections. The Senior Modeller \& Detailer prepares accurate shop drawings, general arrangement drawings, reinforcement details, and assembly drawings in line with project specifications and company standards. Daily tasks include coordinating with design engineers, project managers, and production teams in Ireland to resolve technical queries, ensure model accuracy, and maintain drawing records. The role also requires leading a team of rebar modellers and detailers, checking and reviewing models and drawings, mentoring junior modelers/detailers, and supporting continuous improvement of modelling and detailing workflows.

* Strong proficiency in Tekla Structures for 3D modelling and detailing of precast concrete elements, including floors and structural components.

* Experience producing and checking GA drawings, shop drawings, bar bending schedules, and fabrication/erection drawings.
* Ability to interpret architectural and structural drawings, coordinate with engineering teams, and resolve technical issues in the model.
* Attention to detail, strong quality focus, and ability to manage multiple projects and drawing deadlines.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross\-functional teams, including design, production, and site personnel.

* Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and follow\-up skills.
* Experience in retail, consumer products, e\-commerce, or a multi\-channel business is preferred.

**Job Description:** 
 Data Architect
 



  
 



**Company:** 
 https://www.ldsinfotech.com/
 



**Location:** 

 Mumbai
 

 (Candidates will be considered only for the location they currently reside in or originally belong to. This role does not involve relocation, and inter\-location transfers will not be applicable at the time of hiring.)

 1
 



**Department:** 
 Technical \- Data \& Analytics
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head
 



**Role Type:** 
 Architecture, Implementation \& Customer\-Facing
 



  
 



**About the Role:** 




**LDS Infotech is looking for a Data Architect** 
 with 4–7 years of experience in designing and implementing enterprise data platforms, analytics solutions, data integration frameworks, and data modernization initiatives.
 



 The ideal candidate should combine
 **strong hands\-on data engineering experience with architecture capability** 
 , enabling them to translate business and customer requirements into scalable, secure, high\-performance data solutions.
 



 The role will involve designing target\-state data architectures, leading modernization initiatives, defining data integration and governance standards, participating in customer workshops, supporting solution development and pre\-sales activities, and mentoring Data Engineers.
 



 The candidate will also contribute to establishing and strengthening the
 **LDS Data \& Analytics practice** 
 by creating reusable architecture patterns, implementation standards, documentation, and delivery frameworks.
 



  
 



**Detailed Job Description (Key Responsibilities):** 




**Data Architecture \& Solution Design** 




 o  Design enterprise data architectures aligned with business and technical requirements.
 



 o  Define target\-state data platforms, architecture roadmaps, and technology strategies.
 



 o  Design scalable, secure, reliable, and high\-performance data solutions.
 



 o  Evaluate existing data environments and recommend modernization approaches.
 



 o  Define architecture patterns, technology standards, and reusable frameworks.
 



 o  Review solution designs and validate implementation approaches.
 



**Data Platform \& Modernization** 




 o  Lead data platform modernization and transformation initiatives.
 



 o  Design and implement data lake, data warehouse, and lakehouse architectures.
 



 o  Evaluate and recommend appropriate cloud and data technologies based on project requirements.
 



 o  Define scalable data storage, processing, integration, and analytics architecture.
 



 o  Support migration of legacy data platforms to modern cloud\-based architectures.
 



  
 **Data Integration \& Engineering** 




 o  Define ETL/ELT architecture and data integration strategies.
 



 o  Design batch and real\-time data integration solutions where required.
 



 o  Establish integration patterns for structured and unstructured data sources.
 



 o  Define data ingestion, transformation, processing, and orchestration frameworks.
 



 o  Work closely with Data Engineers to ensure architecture is implemented according to defined standards.
 



**Data Modeling \& Database Architecture** 




 o  Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
 



 o  Define data structures suitable for reporting, analytics, operational and enterprise use cases.
 



 o  Provide guidance on relational and analytical database architecture.
 



 o  Review data models and optimize them for scalability and performance.
 



 o  Identify and address data quality, consistency, and performance challenges.
 



**Data Governance \& Management** 




 o  Establish data governance and data management standards.
 



 o  Define standards for data quality, metadata, lineage, security, access, and lifecycle management.
 



 o  Support implementation of data governance frameworks across customer environments.
 



 o  Contribute to Master Data Management and data stewardship initiatives.
 



 o  Ensure data platforms follow applicable security, governance, and compliance requirements.
 



**Analytics Architecture** 




 o  Design enterprise analytics and reporting architecture.
 



 o  Define integration between data platforms and BI/analytics solutions.
 



 o  Support Power BI and other analytics platform architecture requirements.
 



 o  Design data models optimized for analytics and reporting workloads.
 



 o  Ensure analytics platforms can scale with increasing data volumes and business requirements.
 



**Cloud Data Platform** 




 o  Design cloud\-based data architectures using relevant cloud data services.
 



 o Work with platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Snowflake, and AWS data services, depending on project requirements.
 



 o  Evaluate cloud services and recommend appropriate technologies based on cost, scalability, performance, and business requirements.
 



 o  Support cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
 



**Customer Engagement \& Consulting** 




 o  Lead customer workshops, discovery sessions, and architecture discussions.
 



 o Understand customer business and technical requirements and translate them into data architecture solutions.
 



 o  Present architecture options, recommendations, technical approaches, and implementation roadmaps.
 



 o  Participate in technical discussions with customer stakeholders and internal teams.
 



 o  Communicate complex data concepts clearly to both technical and business stakeholder.
 



**Pre\-Sales \& Solution Development** 




 o  Support pre\-sales activities, solution development, and technical proposals.
 



 o  Contribute to RFP/RFI responses, solution documents, architecture diagrams, and technical presentations.
 



 o  Assist in effort estimation, technology evaluation, and solution planning.
 



 o  Develop reusable solution frameworks and accelerators for future customer engagements.
 








**Preferred Certification:** 



* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate – DP\-203
* Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate – DP\-600
* Databricks Data Engineer Professional



**Certifications are preferred but strong hands\-on project experience will also be considered.** 









**Candidate Requirement:** 



* 4–7 years of hands\-on experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture or Data Platform development.
* Strong experience in data architecture, data modeling, ETL/ELT and database design.
* Hands\-on experience designing Data Warehouse, Data Lake or Lakehouse solutions.
* Strong understanding of cloud data platforms and modern data architecture patterns.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric / Azure Synapse / ADF / Databricks / Snowflake is preferred.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, security, metadata and data lifecycle management.
* Experience in designing scalable, high\-performance data platforms and optimizing data solutions.
* Ability to lead customer workshops, architecture discussions and technical solutioning.
* Strong communication, documentation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to mentor Data Engineers and take ownership of architecture and technical delivery.

title: Senior Wind Consultant
description:
RINA is currently recruiting for a
 **Senior Wind Consultant** 
 to join its office in Delhi within the
 **Renewable Energy Engineering** 
 Division.
   

  

**Mission**
 As Senior Wind Consultant, you'll provide engineering advice and technical solutions to a wide range of clients on wind projects and portfolios across the globe, including lender's technical advisor assignments, technical due diligence, and owner's engineer activities. Depending on your location and experience, there may also be opportunities for international site inspections.
   

  

 You'll guide junior and mid\-level engineers, contribute strategic input during project development and execution, and help ensure engineering activities meet the highest standards of quality, safety, compliance, and technical rigour throughout the full project lifecycle.
   

  

 You'll join RINA's global Wind Discipline, a collaborative, multi\-disciplinary team working at the forefront of the energy transition. We're focused on finding the best fit for our team, so we welcome hybrid working arrangements and are open to applications from across India.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Assess clients’ needs and translate them into clear and concise recommendations within proposals for new work, technical reports and/or other engineering documentation;
* Work as an effective and collaborative member of multi\-disciplinary teams;
* Communicate clearly and effectively with both clients and colleagues, via conference calls, emails and reports;
* Operate with autonomy and take responsibility for the completion and performance of assigned projects, under the coordination of the Project Manager;
* Plan and evaluate technical solutions: engineering consultants find unique ways to resolve technical issues without affecting the overall completion deadline or affecting the involvement from other departments or external companies;
* Develop project schedules and deliverable timelines; successfully managing the delivery of assignments on time and to budget, meeting client expectations;
* Support proposals and bids for new assignments by drafting scopes of work and execution plans that meet client requirements;
* Conduct local and international site inspections, depending on candidate location and experience;
* Support the continued development of more junior team personnel, providing technical guidance;
* Support managers in cultivating new competencies within the team and in delivering technical training;
* Undertake quality assurance of technical deliverables to ensure the highest standard. Ensure that all assigned activities are executed in accordance with RINA’s Quality Policy;
* Support business development activities, building relationships with clients and helping to generate new business.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's/Master's degree(s) in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related fields.
* 8\+ years of technical experience in renewables, preferably with a focus on wind technologies.
* Strong written and spoken communication skills in English. Ability to engage effectively with clients, contractors and stakeholders.
* Strong expertise in feasibility studies, design review, grid integration and technical due diligence.
* Proficiency with key engineering tools is desirable (e.g. Civil 3D, STAAD.Pro, ETABS, Python, windPRO, Meteodyn).
* Familiarity with key design standards (e.g. IEC standards, Eurocodes, environmental and HSE regulations).


**Competencies**
* DOMAIN \& BUSINESS ACUMEN \- Applying a scientific approach and critical thinking in operations and solution development within area of expertise.
* FORESIGHT \& INSIGHT \- Context awareness adopting a systemic perspective and informed decision making.
* INTERPERSONAL INFLUENCE \- Skills and strategies we use to interact effectively with others.
* PERSONAL EMPOWERMENT \- Ownership for life, work and results, striving to grow professionally and personally.
* WORKPLACE DYNAMICS \- Resourcefulness in shaping progress and working efficiently.


 RINA is a multinational company providing a wide range of services in the energy, marine, certification, infrastructure \& mobility, industry, research \& development sectors. Our business model covers the full process of project development, from concept to completion.
   

  

*At RINA, we endeavor to create a work environment where every single person is valued and encouraged to develop new ideas. We provide equal employment opportunities and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected and safe from discrimination or harassment of any kind. We are also compliant to the Italian Law n. 68/99\.*

title: Lead Architect
description:
**About Us**
 Join us at Orange Business!
   

  

 We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
   

  

 Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a visionary Lead Architect with over 15 years of experience to join our Integration delivery team. In this role, you will be a strategic leader responsible for designing and delivering complex, large\-scale integration, cloud\-native environments. You will drive the architectural vision for our clients, ensuring high\-performance, secure, and cost\-optimized digital transformations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Architecture Strategy \& Leadership** 
 : Define and drive the end\-to\-end architectural roadmap for digital integration, application modernization, and cloud\-native adoption.
   

  

**Cloud \& Application Modernization** 
 : Lead the migration of monolithic legacy applications to microservices\-based, containerised (Docker/Kubernetes) architectures on major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
   

  

**AI / ML Solution Engineering** 
 : Design and implement AI\-based solutions, including Generative AI patterns (RAG, agent workflows) vector databases, and prompt engineering and enhance business processes.
   

  

 Design the end\-to\-end ML lifecycle (MLOps), covering data ingestion, model training, deployment, and automated retraining workflows.
   

  

 Build AI\-enabled applications using Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and prompt engineering
   

  

**FinOps \& Cost Governance** 
 : Establish and oversee FinOps frameworks to optimize cloud spend, ensuring that architectural decisions align with financial efficiency and business value.
   

  

**Application \& SaaS Integration** 
 : Design of robust API\-led and event\-driven integration frameworks using tools like MuleSoft, Apigee, Tibco or Kafka.
   

  

 SaaS integration strategies for major platforms (Salesforce, Workday, SAP, ServiceNow) using iPaaS and Unified APIs.
   

  

 Enforce best practices for multi\-tenant SaaS architecture, including OAuth 2\.0 and secure identity management.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management** 
 : Serve as a trusted advisor to C\-suite executives, translating complex technical requirements into strategic business outcomes.
   

  

**Mentorship \& Governance** 
 : Establish architectural standards and mentor a high\-performing team of architects and engineers.
   

  

**About You**
**Experience** 
 : Minimum 15\+ years in IT, with at least 8 years in a Lead/Principal Architect role focused on Digital Integration and Cloud.
   

  

**Cloud Expertise** 
 : Deep hands\-on experience with Cloud Architecture (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS) and multi\-cloud strategies.
   

  

**Modernization Depth** 
 : Proven track record in Application Modernization, including refactoring legacy systems into microservices and serverless architectures.
   

  

**AI/ML Skills** 
 : Practical experience in delivering production\-grade AI\-enabled solutions, with knowledge of LLMs, vector databases, and AI\-native data integration.
   

  

**FinOps Proficiency** 
 : Strong understanding of FinOps principles, including cost modeling, forecasting, and resource optimization.
   

  

**Bachelor’s/Master’s Degree** 
 in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field.
   

  

 AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional / Google Professional Cloud Architect / Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert. FinOps Certified Practitioner (FCP) or FinOps Certified Architect OGAF 9\.2/10 Certification Databricks Certified Solutions Architect, Google Professional Data Engineer, or AWS Certified Machine Learning Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or SAFe Agilist (Leading SAFe).
   

  

 You bring a can\-do attitude, tackle challenges head\-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Global Opportunities: Work in multi\-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re\-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well\-being programs and benefits, diversity \& inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.


**Only Your Skills Matter**
 Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled\-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

description:

**Department :** 
 Technology Consulting/Technology Strategy and Transformation

 Manager
   

  

**Job Title : Strategy Manager**
**THE OPPORTUNITY** 
 : EY's Technology Strategy \& Transformation (TST) team is at the forefront of delivering cutting\-edge consulting and advisory services to some of the largest enterprises across the globe. Our technology practice is recognized by industry analysts as a leader in leveraging business and technology to drive strategic business\-led, tech\-enabled e2e transformation. We serve clients across all major industries and work with organizations of different sizes, helping guide them to achieve business success while delivering strategic IT value.
   

  

**Scope of engagements**
 We are currently seeking experienced, seasoned IT Strategy practitioners who can be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and customer to devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. * reset, reimagine and re\-think their business and operating models with tech\-enabled, cutting\-edge solutions that re\-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams
* drive increased value from technology spend with focus on optimizing cost, agility, productivity and performance

Working closely with our industry groups and leveraging the Ernst \& Young brand as independent, trusted advisors, we provide our high\-profile clients with range of services including:
   

  

* Tech Strategy \& Vision
* IT Operating Model optimization
* Transformation strategy, roadmaps \& blueprints
* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
* Product strategy \& management
* M\&A due\-diligence, planning and post integration/separation

* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech\-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications

Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.

* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership
* Build and develop trusted relationships as a strategic technology advisor with clients and work internally across EY advisory teams to bring our clients the most comprehensive, end\-to\-end services and effectively address their business challenges.

* Managing engagement teams and providing leadership in the assessment, design, and management of successful Business \- IT transformation engagements in collaboration with our clients. * Help recruit, develop and retain strategy professionals, coach and mentor team members, deliver architecture\-related training and take on other practice management tasks as needed (e.g., development of practice offerings)

* Create expert content for point\-of\-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C\-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier\-1 B\-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 10\+ years of relevant experience in large\-scale, enterprise\-wide transformations
* Min. of 10\+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e\-commerce, etc.

* Experience with assessing maturity of IT operating models \& organizations structure to determine optimization opportunities. Should understand IT \- business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re\-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next\-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).
* Conducting research and analyses of operational effectiveness, processes, stakeholders, etc., creating end\-to\-end visibility into how the organization executes their operations today and identifying systemic issues impacting business performance

* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies

* Advanced business and/or technology degrees from tier\-1 schools (MBA, Masters)
* Experience in presenting directly to the C\-Suite and explain complex concepts to anyone from an intern to a CFO, CHRO or CMO
* Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the strategic and improvement agenda.

**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on HR Technology professional to support the transformation of our HR tech landscape into a more integrated, scalable, and AI\-ready ecosystem over the next 12–24 months.
 



 The role combines ownership of existing HR systems with responsibility for driving future technology transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate will bring strong HR process understanding, HRIS implementation and administration experience, problem\-solving ability, and a passion for leveraging technology to improve HR effectiveness and employee experience.
 



 This role is suited for a strong individual contributor or first\-time manager who can balance day\-to\-day system ownership with strategic transformation initiatives.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\. HR Technology Transformation** 



* Support the HR technology roadmap and digital transformation initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and AI adoption.
* Evaluate and implement new HR technology solutions aligned to business needs.
* Drive process redesign and technology\-enabled improvements across the employee lifecycle.



**2\. HR Systems Implementation \& Administration** 



* Gather business requirements and translate them into functional specifications, user stories, solution designs, and system configurations.
* Manage implementations, enhancements, upgrades, testing, go\-lives, and post\-implementation support.
* Act as the functional owner and administrator for HR technology platforms.
* Manage system configurations, workflows, business rules, user roles, and permissions.
* Ensure platform stability, data integrity, seamless user experience, and operational excellence.
* Monitor system performance, manage issue resolution, and coordinate with vendors and internal teams.



**3\. Solutioning \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
* Identify process gaps and system limitations and recommend enhancements or workarounds.
* Drive system optimization, automation, integrations, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Troubleshoot complex system and process issues using logical and structured problem\-solving.



**4\. Governance \& Vendor Management** 



* Manage vendor relationships, enhancement backlogs, SLAs, and support models.
* Maintain process documentation, SOPs, governance standards, and compliance requirements.
* Ensure timely delivery of projects, upgrades, and enhancements.



**5\. Adoption \& Capability Building** 



* Drive user adoption of HR technology platforms.
* Conduct training and enablement sessions for HR teams and stakeholders.
* Promote best practices and standardized HR processes



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Existing HR systems are stable, well\-governed, and effectively utilized.
* HR users have a reliable and seamless technology experience.
* Technology\-driven process improvements and automations are consistently delivered.
* System gaps are proactively identified and addressed with practical solutions.
* The HR technology landscape becomes increasingly integrated, scalable, data\-driven, and AI\-ready over the next 12–24 months.
* The individual is viewed as the trusted HR technology expert and solution partner across HR and business teams.



  





**Desired Skills \& Experience** 



* 4–5 years of experience in HR Technology, along with 3\+ years of experience implementing HR and enterprise systems.
* Strong understanding of the HR domain, with the ability to effectively communicate with business stakeholders and translate business requirements into technology solutions.
* Proven experience in integrating HRMS/HCM platforms with other enterprise systems.
* Hands\-on experience with configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and process automation.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and solution design capabilities.
* Ability to bridge business requirements with system capabilities.
* Familiarity with integrations, workflows, automation, and AI\-enabled HR solutions.
* Strong project management, stakeholder management, and execution skills.
* Good working knowledge of dashboards and reporting tools such as Tableau.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in HR, Engineering, Information Systems, or related fields.
* Experience with HRMS/HCM platforms such as Darwinbox, SAP SuccessFactors or similar systems.
* Experience in digital transformation, platform implementation, or HR technology modernization initiatives.
* Exposure to AI, automation, chatbot, or workflow technologies is preferred.
* Experience working within high\-growth, agile, and rapidly evolving organizations will be an advantage.



  





**Equal Opportunity** 




 Zeta is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

title: Senior Copywriter
description:
Dear future Punter,
 



  





 At some point, you stopped being impressed by things that were merely well\-made.
 



 You started looking for something harder to explain.
 



 A kind of sharpness.
 



 A point of view that holds, even when everything around it shifts.
 



*Work that doesn’t try too hard to be liked, but ends up being remembered anyway.* 




*That’s the space we try to work in.* 




 Not always successfully.
 



 But
 *always deliberately* 
 .
 



 A punter lovessss to share food and credit with equal gusto, because they know that when the tide rises, it lifts everyone along with it.
 



  





 If this sounds like you, read on:
 



  





**Job Role: Senior Copywriter** 




**Location: Andheri West, Mumbai** 




  





 Here's what you'll do:
 



  




* Take a brief and push it somewhere more interesting than where it started. Sometimes the best ideas come from a random observation, a strange reference, or a thought that initially sounds slightly stupid until everyone in the room realises it’s actually great.



  




* Work closely with the Art team to build ideas together instead of treating copy and design like separate departments forced to sit next to each other. Around here, you'll see that the strongest work usually comes from people bouncing thoughts off each other, making things sharper together, and caring equally about the writing, the visuals, and the final impact of the work.



  




* Write across formats, platforms, and brands without making everything sound the same. We want someone who enjoys figuring out the tone, rhythm, and personality every piece of communication needs.



  




* Stay curious about culture, the internet, trends, conversations, films, comments sections, design, music, weird niche communities, and all the tiny things people are obsessed with this week. You don’t need to chase every trend, but you should understand why people care about them in the first place.



  




* Bring opinions into the room. Pitch thoughts. Question obvious routes. Fight for ideas when they deserve it, but also know how to move on gracefully when a direction changes. Advertising can be chaotic sometimes, and the people who do well here are usually the ones who stay excited about making the next thing better instead of getting stuck mourning the last thing.



  




* Pay attention to your craft because the small details matter more than people think. A good line can become forgettable if the timing is off by half a second.



  




* Contribute to brainstorms, campaigns, shoots, presentations, social content, and the occasional last\-minute idea that somehow turns into the thing the client buys immediately. Great work rarely arrives in a perfectly organised way, so being adaptable matters.



  





**What we're looking for:** 




  




* **2\+ years in advertising as a copywriter**
* A strong portfolio with personality and range
* Comfortable writing across formats and platforms
* Good conceptual thinking skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Awareness of internet culture and platform behaviour
* Film, scriptwriting, or content creation experience is a bonus

title: Junior Clinical Case Manager
description:
**About Lyra**
 Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer\-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer\-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life\-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI\-powered platform combining the highest\-quality care and technology solutions.
   

  

 The Junior Clinical Case Manager (Jr. CCM) operates as a vital link between direct clinical care and operational oversight within Lyra Health’s mental health delivery model in India. This permanent position encompasses first\-line helpline and crisis management, clinical intake triage, and the delivery of structured, workplace\-focused short\-term therapy. Beyond direct care, the role drives quality assurance and operational compliance by auditing clinical documentation, monitoring outcome metrics such as CORE\-10, preventing clinical drift, and managing affiliate network relationships and onboarding. Requiring a Master’s degree in Clinical or Counseling Psychology, three to six years of progressive clinical experience—preferably in EAP or corporate mental health environments—and fluency in English and Hindi, the Jr. CCM blends high\-level clinical risk assessment with detail\-oriented case management to ensure high quality, scalable care across the provider network.
   

  

**Purpose Of The Job**
 To manage clinical operations, facilitate referrals, and monitor the quality of care delivered by the provider network.
   

  

 It is a permanent position focused on operationalizing high\-quality clinical care.
   

  

 Working Hours: 48 hours per week.
   

  

 Schedule: 5 or 6 days a week; various shifts may be applicable.
   

  

 Hybrid Work: Hybrid working can be considered as per the need of the job.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Helpline \& Crisis Management


 Serve as the primary first point of contact for employees and their dependents accessing the Lyra helpline via telephone, live chat, or email.
   

  

 Provide immediate "in\-the\-moment" clinical support to callers in distress, utilizing psychological first aid and stabilization techniques.
   

  

 Conduct comprehensive clinical risk assessments for every contact to identify potential self\-harm, ideation, or risk to others, adhering to Lyra’s established risk protocols.
   

  

 Manage emergency interventions and coordinate with local emergency services or internal senior clinical leads when high\-risk situations are identified.
   

  

* Clinical Intake \& Triage


 Conduct detailed clinical intake interviews to assess the user’s presenting concerns, history, and level of psychological distress.
   

  

 Evaluate the appropriateness of short\-term counseling versus higher\-acuity care pathways based on the clinical assessment.
   

  

 Utilize internal decision\-making frameworks to assign clients to the most suitable professional within the in\-house team or the partner provider network, matching based on clinical specialty and language preference.
   

  

 Accurately capture and document all clinical intake data, including CORE\-10 scores and work impact metrics, in the database to ensure a seamless handover to the treating clinician.
   

  

* Delivery of Clinical Sessions


 Provide high\-quality, professional counseling and psychotherapy sessions to clients within a structured, short\-term framework.
   

  

 Utilize evidence\-based interventions (such as CBT or solution\-focused therapy) to address client queries and specific mental health concerns.
   

  

 Ensure all clinical sessions are workplace\-focused when appropriate, helping the service user improve their level of functioning and productivity.
   

  

 Maintain accurate, contemporaneous clinical notes for every session, ensuring they meet the legal and professional standards of the Indian healthcare landscape.
   

  

 Monitor client progress through regular outcome measurement and adjust the treatment plan as necessary, or escalate to the Senior CCM for complex case review.
   

  

* Documentation Oversight \& Quality Assurance


 Conduct systematic monitoring of all active clinical cases from initiation to closure to ensure strict adherence to Lyra’s clinical documentation standards.
   

  

 Proactively follow up with internal clinicians and affiliate providers to secure missing or delayed clinical notes, treatment plans, and discharge summaries.
   

  

 Audit case files for the accurate inclusion of outcome measurements, specifically tracking the consistent use of CORE\-10 and work impact scores.
   

  

 Ensure all clinical documentation is captured within the database in a timely manner, maintaining a high standard of data integrity for audit readiness.
   

  

 Identify and escalate recurring documentation gaps to the Senior CCM to facilitate targeted provider training and performance management.
   

  

* Affiliate Network \& Specialty Support


 Serve as the primary point of operational contact for the partner provider network, offering continuous support regarding administrative and portal requirements.
   

  

 Maintain and verify the accuracy of the affiliate database, ensuring all partner providers have professional, updated bios that reflect their current clinical expertise.
   

  

 Routinely audit and update provider specialties and language proficiencies to ensure the intake team can perform precise referral matching.
   

  

 Assist in the onboarding process by training new affiliates on Lyra’s specific clinical protocols, risk management procedures, and case referral workflows.
   

  

 Support partner providers in navigating cross\-border referral processes and understanding local compliance nuances.
   

  

* Protocol Adherence


 Intervention Alignment: Rigorously audit treatment plans to ensure all clinical interventions align with Lyra’s evidence\-based, short\-term, and solution\-focused models.
   

  

 Workplace Focus Integration: Evaluate clinical goals to ensure they are specifically designed to improve the service user’s level of functioning within the workplace, focusing on "Work Impact" and productivity restoration.
   

  

 Goal\-Oriented Care: Verify that every treatment plan includes clear, measurable objectives that can be reasonably achieved within the prescribed short\-term session limit.
   

  

 Clinical Gatekeeping: Identify and address "clinical drift" where therapy may be deviating from the brief intervention framework or losing its workplace\-centric focus.
   

  

 Standardized Assessment Review: Monitor the consistent application of clinical outcome measures (such as CORE\-10\) to validate that the intervention protocol is resulting in measurable symptom reduction.
   

  

 Provider Consultation: Provide direct feedback and consultation to partner providers when treatment plans do not meet Lyra’s specific clinical protocols or service level agreements.
   

  

 Case Escalation: Manage the transition of cases that require longer\-term or higher\-acuity care, ensuring the handover remains compliant with Lyra’s global clinical standards and local professional guidelines.
   

  

* Miscellaneous


 Upholding Lyra Values: Act as a brand ambassador by consistently demonstrating Lyra’s core values of clinical excellence, innovation, and empathy in every interaction with colleagues, providers, and service users.
   

  

 Task Ownership \& Accountability: Ensure all allotted clinical and administrative tasks are performed with high precision and within agreed\-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
   

  

 Process Optimization Initiatives: Proactively identify gaps in current workflows and take the initiative to propose and implement solutions that enhance operational efficiency and clinical outcomes.
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Coordination: Collaborate seamlessly with the Clinical Lead, Client Success, and Product teams to ensure the delivery of the highest quality care to both clients (companies) and individual customers.
   

  

 Workshop Delivery \& Training: Participate in opportunities to deliver onsite or online workshops and training sessions for client organizations as requested.
   

  

 Content Creation: Contribute to the development of clinical content, training manuals, and affiliate\-facing materials to maintain Lyra’s position as a thought leader in mental health.
   

  

 Event Participation: Represent Lyra Health at professional events, webinars, and industry conferences to promote Lyra’s transformative care model and clinical research.
   

  

**Experience**
 Qualification: Masters in Clinical or Counseling Psychology; RCI registration is desirable.
   

  

 Experience Level: 3–6 years of progressive working experience in a clinical setting.
   

  

 Specialized Experience: Strong preference for candidates with a background in EAP or workplace mental health, particularly with work\-impact cases.
   

  

 Global Exposure: Experience navigating diverse healthcare systems and cultural nuances is preferred.
   

  

 Technical Skills: Proficiency in Google Suite and CRM systems.
   

  

 Linguistic Skills: Must be bilingual in Hindi and English.
   

  

**About You**
 Clinical Acumen: Strong clinical understanding with the ability to identify and assess clinical risk within a case management framework.
   

  

 Problem Solver: Analytical approach to solving operational bottlenecks and navigating network challenges.
   

  

 Autonomous \& Accountable: Able to manage individual caseload responsibilities and escalate clinical concerns accurately.
   

  

 Detail\-Oriented: Meticulous attention to detail in monitoring clinical notes and auditing outcome measurements (CORE\-10\).
   

  

 Communicator: Clear verbal and written skills for managing relationships with external providers and internal teams.
   

  

 Proactive \& Adaptive: Continuous improvement mindset to refine referral and coordination processes.
   

  

 Organized: Exceptional ability to prioritize operational tasks and meet reporting deadlines under pressure.
   

  

 Collaborative: Collaborates effectively with internal stakeholders to achieve a seamless global account experience.

title: Global Service Desk Analyst
description:
Who we are
 



 Broadway Malyan is a global architecture, urbanism and design practice dedicated to creating cities, buildings and places that will provide a lasting legacy. Through a shared design ethos, we work together to create places with a strong sense of identity where people and communities want to live, learn, shop, work and relax.
 



 As an employee\-owned practice, we are able to create an inclusive culture where everyone has a strong sense of engagement and shared responsibility in the future of our business. We are committed to investing and inspiring our people, so we can attract and retain the best talent to strengthen our reputation as both a design practice and an employer of choice.
 



  





 About the role
 



 Broadway Malyan is currently seeking to recruit an enthusiastic, customer\-facing Global Service Desk Analyst (L1\). Based out of our Mumbai Studio, you will be the first point of contact for our global staff, ensuring service excellence within our newly established 24/7 "Follow\-the\-Sun" support structure.
 



  





 Key responsibilities:
 



 The Global Service Desk Analyst is a fundamental part of our customer support structure. The purpose of this role is to ensure effective and highly responsive L1 support to our colleagues across our global architectural studios (including the UK, Europe, Middle East, and APAC).
 



 Working on behalf of the Group IT department, this role operates on a 24/7 rotational shift pattern. Standard business\-hour shifts will be conducted from our Mumbai Studio, while out\-of\-hours, night, and weekend shifts will be conducted remotely (Work\-From\-Home).
 



  





 This entails (amongst other tasks):
 


* Acting as the first point of contact (via portal, email, and phone) for all IT Service requests and incidents globally.
* Delivering a premium, empathetic customer service experience to our architectural and design staff.
* Utilizing and guiding users through our automated IT Self\-Service Portals to expedite ticket resolution.
* Active Directory and Microsoft 365 administration (user management, permissions, mailbox troubleshooting).
* Basic troubleshooting of endpoint hardware, Windows 11 OS, and standard software.
* Providing L1 technical triage for heavy design applications (AutoCAD, Revit, Adobe CC) and routing functional workflow issues to our embedded Digital Design Specialists.
* Ensuring all incidents are accurately logged, categorized, and updated within the Helpdesk platform.



  





 What we’re looking for
 



 We are looking for someone who brings:
 


* Exceptional communication skills in English \[verbal and written] are paramount. The candidate must possess excellent verbal communication skills with a clear, professional deliver and exhibit excellent business etiquette.
* 2 to 4 years of proven experience in an International IT Service Desk / Global Helpdesk environment.
* Shift Flexibility: Absolute willingness to work on a 24/7 rotational roster. This includes morning, evening, and night shifts, as well as rotational weekends and Public/Bank Holidays.
* WFH Readiness: Must possess a quiet, dedicated workspace at home with a highly stable, high\-speed broadband connection for out\-of\-hours shifts.
* Customer\-oriented, possessing high empathy and patience when dealing with users.
* Excellent analysis, problem\-solving, and organizational capacity.
* Technically oriented with solid knowledge of O365, Active Directory, Windows OS, and standard IT Service Management (ITSM) ticketing tools.
* Exposure to ITIL methodologies or relevant IT accreditations (CompTIA, Microsoft fundamentals) is desirable but not essential.



  





 We offer
 



 • Highly Competitive Compensation: A strong base salary (CTC) aligned with top\-tier international service desks.
 



 • Allowances: Monthly shift allowances for unsociable hours, plus a Work\-From\-Home internet stipend.
 



 • Holiday Pay: Standard rotational days off, with double\-pay/compensatory leave for working mandatory Public Holidays.
 



 • Hybrid Working: A balanced model combining the vibrant atmosphere of our Mumbai design studio with the convenience of remote work for late/weekend shifts.
 



 • Technical career growth: Integration into a global IT team with exposure to advanced automation and enterprise environments.
 



 • Professional environment, comprised of skilled and collaborative/supportive colleagues.
 



 • Pleasant and friendly multicultural atmosphere.
 



  





 Conclusion
 



 If you are a dynamic professional, willing to develop and excel in a technical environment and ready to take new challenges, we're waiting for your application.

title: Performance Marketer & Business Consultant
description:
Performance Marketing \& Business Consultant
 

**TYS · Mumbai, Maharashtra (On\-site — Vikhroli) · Full\-time** 




  





 What TYS Actually Is
 


 Seven years and multiple pivots in, TYS has become something specific: a business consultancy with execution capabilities. Think McKinsey\-level strategic thinking — but for businesses that need someone to actually
 
*do the work* 

 , not just hand over a slide deck.
 




  






 Our clients range from early\-stage D2C brands to established businesses looking to scale. That means we're as comfortable deriving unit economics and fixing shipping partner inefficiencies as we are scaling Meta campaigns and segmenting retention cohorts.
 




  






 Performance marketing is our backbone, but the role goes well beyond media buying. If you're someone who thinks in business outcomes rather than ad metrics alone — keep reading.
 




  





 What You'll Be Doing
 


 You won't just manage ad accounts. You'll operate as a consultant who happens to execute — or an executor who happens to think strategically. The day\-to\-day includes:
 




  




* **Meta Ads** 

 — Conversion campaigns, non\-conversion (awareness/traffic), remarketing funnels, creative strategy, and audience architecture.
* **Google Ads** 

 — Search, Display, Standard Shopping, Performance Max, and YouTube. You should be comfortable building and optimising across the full Google stack.
* **Retention Marketing** 

 — Customer segmentation, lifecycle flows, email/SMS/WhatsApp campaigns, and the copywriting that powers them.
* **Snapchat Ads** 

 — Conversion, non\-conversion, and remarketing. Bonus if you've worked with other emerging platforms.
* **Content Strategy** 

 — Content curation, competitor referencing, and original content ideation that ties back to business and campaign objectives.
* **Business Consulting** 

 — Working directly with clients on unit math, margin analysis, marketplace growth strategy, shipping and ops efficiencies, and anything else that sits between "we have a product" and "we have a profitable business."



  






 Some weeks you'll be deep inside an ad account. Other weeks you'll be in a room with a founder rethinking their entire go\-to\-market. That range is the point.
 




  





 Who We're Looking For
 

**You should bring:** 




  




* Hands\-on experience running and scaling paid campaigns across Meta and Google — not just boosted posts, but structured, full\-funnel campaign builds.
* A working understanding of business fundamentals: contribution margins, CAC, LTV, blended ROAS, and how they connect to actual profitability.
* The ability to write — whether it's ad copy, retention emails, or a client\-facing strategy document. Clear thinking shows up in clear writing.
* Comfort with data. You can pull insights from ad dashboards, GA4, and spreadsheets without needing someone to interpret them for you.
* Strong communication and client\-facing skills. You'll be speaking directly with founders and leadership teams.



  





**What would make you stand out:** 




  




* Experience across both media buying and broader business strategy — not just one or the other.
* Exposure to marketplace growth (Amazon, Flipkart, etc.) or D2C brand scaling.
* Familiarity with tools like Shopify, Klaviyo, Business on Bot, Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity, or similar.
* A genuine curiosity about how businesses work.



  





 The Four Pillars We Hire On
 


 This matters enough to call out explicitly. At TYS, we evaluate every hire on four things:
 




  





**Intellect** 

 — Can you think clearly, learn quickly, and solve problems that don't come with a playbook?
 




  





**Discipline** 

 — Do you show up, follow through, and hold yourself to a standard without being managed into it?
 




  





**Trust** 

 — Can we hand you a client relationship and know you'll protect it? Can we give you context and know it stays where it should?
 




  





**Temperament** 

 — Can you handle pressure, ambiguity, and the occasional difficult conversation without losing your composure or your kindness?
 




  






 Intellect gets you in the door. The other three determine how far you go.
 




  





 Logistics
 
* **Location:** 

 This is a 100% in\-office role. We work out of Vikhroli, Mumbai. No remote or hybrid arrangements.
* **Joining:** 

 We're looking for someone who can start immediately or within a short notice period.
* **Website:** 


 www.toldyouso.in
 
 is still a work in progress — but a quick look at the founder's profile will give you a clearer picture of what we're building and why.

**Job Summary:**

* 24/7 Monitoring: Monitor DTC/CAN parameters at the Command Centre and raise tickets immediately when an issue is detected.

* Customer Assistance: Provide Level 1 (L1\) support over the phone, guiding customers/drivers to resolve minor issues.

MSX International remains the go\-to partner for leading automotive OEMs, offering innovative, research\-driven strategies to elevate retail operations and accelerate business growth.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Salesforce/Technical
description:
We are a Salesforce \& Microsoft Product(ISV) Partner, and looking for FDEs to work with our large Indian customers for our AI\-driven security and compliance platform.
 



  





 What a forward deployed engineer is:
 



 You configure and build for a customer you actually meet \- you're in their office, embedded with their team, and focus on their success.
 



  





 What you own:
 



  




* The data. Parsers that land a customer's exports in the platform's model, then de\-duplicate across systems and match records to an inventory that's rarely kept tidy
* The connections. Live connectors — their APIs, ServiceNow, Jira, auth, pagination, retries, alerts when a feed goes quiet
* The code. Custom transforms where configuration runs out — the first connector for a tool that's new to the platform
* The deployment. Integrate with customer's own cloud, sometimes on\-premise and air\-gapped



  





 We look for solid Apex/Python experience because that's where the integration instincts get built — auth, retries, governor limits, sandbox\-to\-prod discipline. Those instincts transfer directly; only the syntax changes.
 



  





 What we're looking for:
 



  




* 2–3 years of hands\-on technical delivery, customer\-facing — Salesforce partner, SI or consultancy



 Real integration engineering. Apex first; ServiceNow, Java, .NET or Python welcome too
 


* Comfortable declaratively too — objects, flows, permission sets. You configure as much as you code
* Clear thinking about data and volume — every production surprise has been a volume one
* Clear, confident English — you'll explain constraints to a customer's architects
* AI is a working method here, not a feature you switch on. The bar goes beyond configuring a packaged assistant — you should already use AI to inspect data, debug real code, and test its output rather than accept it as\-is.
* In the interview you'll work a real problem with AI and say what you trusted and rejected.
* Hard requirement \- Daily onsite across Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai — fully in\-person



  





 Available immediately or within 45 days.
