title: Head of Platform Monetization
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai – Andheri West
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Work From Office
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





**About Pinkvilla** 




 Pinkvilla is India's leading entertainment and lifestyle content platform, reaching over 50 million users monthly across web, mobile, and social media. Backed by Flipkart, Pinkvilla covers Bollywood, television, regional cinema, Hollywood and Korean entertainment, and produces marquee properties such as the Pinkvilla Screen and Style Icons Awards. As part of the Flipkart Group, Pinkvilla is building a structured internal go\-to\-market to make its media, content, and event properties available to Flipkart's own business units as a marketing and brand\-building resource.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Pinkvilla \- a Flipkart Group Company, is looking for a strategic and commercially driven Head of Platform Monetization to lead and scale monetization across Pinkvilla’s social media and video ecosystem.
 



 The role will be responsible for maximizing revenue from Pinkvilla’s social and video audience through advertising, original IPs, sponsorship, and other innovative commercial opportunities.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in digital media monetization, social/video revenue and commercial strategy, with a proven ability to convert audience, content and digital IPs into scalable revenue.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Monetization Strategy** 



* Develop and own the overall monetization strategy across Pinkvilla’s social and video ecosystem.
* Identify new and scalable revenue opportunities across social platforms and video channels.
* Develop annual and quarterly monetization plans and revenue targets.
* Identify emerging monetization formats, platforms and commercial models.
* Balance revenue generation with audience experience and content quality.



  





**2\. Social \& Video Monetization** 



* Drive monetization across: YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat and other relevant social and video platforms
* Maximize revenue from platform advertising and available monetization programs.
* Identify opportunities to improve revenue yield from existing content and audience.
* Develop platform\-specific commercial strategies based on audience behaviour and content formats.
* Explore new formats for monetizing short\-form and long\-form video content.



  





**3\. Original IPs \& Sponsorships** 



* Develop innovative Original IPs and sponsorship opportunities across social and video platforms.
* Create scalable commercial formats for brands and advertisers.
* Work closely with Content, Production, Social Media and Sales teams to develop integrated brand solutions.
* Develop and monetize original content properties and IPs.
* Identify opportunities for category\-specific sponsorships and long\-term brand associations.
* Build repeatable commercial formats rather than relying only on one\-off campaigns.



  





**4\. Revenue Growth \& Business Development** 



* Identify new revenue streams and commercial opportunities.
* Develop monetization packages and propositions for brands and agencies.
* Work closely with the Sales team to convert platform opportunities into revenue.
* Build strong relationships with advertisers, agencies, brands and relevant digital ecosystem partners.
* Identify high\-value categories and advertisers aligned with Pinkvilla’s audience.
* Explore strategic partnerships that can contribute to revenue growth.



  





**5\. Data \& Revenue Optimization** 



* Establish and monitor key monetization metrics and revenue dashboards.
* Analyze content and platform performance to identify revenue opportunities.
* Track metrics such as:
* Revenue per user
* CPM / CPC / CPV
* Video monetization
* Ad yield
* Engagement
* Views and watch time
* Audience growth
* Revenue by platform and content type
* Use data and audience insights to optimize monetization strategies.
* Develop revenue forecasts and track performance against targets.



  





**6\. Content \& IP Monetization** 



* Identify content categories and formats with strong commercial potential.
* Work with content teams to develop commercially viable original formats and IPs.
* Build sponsorship opportunities around shows, series, events and special content properties.
* Identify opportunities to extend successful content formats across multiple platforms.
* Develop long\-term monetization strategies for high\-performing IPs.



  





**7\. Cross\-Functional Leadership** 



* Work closely with Sales, Content, Editorial, Social Media, Video, Production and Marketing teams.
* Ensure monetization opportunities are incorporated into content planning and new formats.
* Partner with senior leadership on new revenue initiatives.
* Establish processes for testing, measuring and scaling monetization opportunities.
* Lead and mentor the monetization team.



  





**Key Requirements** 



* 10–12 years of experience in digital media, social media monetization, video monetization, digital advertising, media revenue or a related field.
* Proven experience in social and video platform monetization.
* Strong understanding of YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and other digital platforms.
* Proven track record of driving digital revenue growth.
* Strong understanding of advertising and sponsorship models.
* Strong commercial and business\-development acumen.
* Data\-driven approach to revenue optimization.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional leadership skills.
* Ability to build new revenue models and commercial opportunities from the ground up.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience in digital media, entertainment, publishing, OTT, social media or creator economy.
* Strong experience in YouTube monetization and digital video.
* Experience working with social media platforms and their monetization ecosystems.
* Experience developing branded content and sponsorship models.
* Experience creating and monetizing original content/IPs.
* Strong network across advertisers, agencies and brands.

description:
**Senior Software Engineering:** 




**E\-Commerce Marketplaces \& AI Supply chain \& Logistics Tech Product Build** 




  





**Goldfishh Supply Chain Technologies Pvt. Ltd. \- www.goldfishh.com** 




  





 We’re looking for a senior technology builder who doesn’t just want to maintain software — but wants to
 **architect and build technology products from the ground up.** 




 Goldfishh operates at the intersection of
 **Supply Chain, Warehousing, 3PL, E\-Commerce and Marketplace Commerce** 
 . As we scale our physical and digital ecosystem, we are embarking on an ambitious technology journey to build
 **AI\-powered platforms that can fundamentally change how businesses manage warehousing, fulfilment, logistics and marketplace commerce.** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Software Engineering / Product Technology leader** 
 who wants to be part of this journey from an early stage.
 



  





**What You Will Build** 




 You will play a key role in architecting and developing technology platforms across:
 



 •
 **N2N / Multi\-Sided Digital Marketplaces** 
 connecting businesses, service providers, infrastructure and supply\-chain capacity.
 



 •
 **E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Technology** 
 integrating marketplaces, D2C platforms, OMS, WMS, inventory, fulfilment, advertising, pricing and revenue optimisation.
 



 •
 **Warehousing \& 3PL Technology** 
 for distributed warehouse networks, fulfilment operations, inventory visibility and supply\-chain orchestration.
 



 •
 **AI\-Native Products \& Agents** 
 using Generative AI, LLMs, machine learning, intelligent automation and agentic workflows.
 



 •
 **Data \& Decision Intelligence** 
 capable of converting large volumes of operational, commercial and marketplace data into actionable recommendations.
 



 •
 **APIs \& Integrations** 
 connecting ERP, WMS, OMS, TMS, marketplaces, e\-commerce platforms, logistics partners and enterprise systems.
 



 The objective is not simply to digitise existing processes.
 



**We want to rethink them.** 




  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




 You should ideally have:
 



 •
 **10–15\+ years of software engineering / technology product development experience.** 




 • BE / BTech or equivalent engineering degree, preferably from a
 **premier engineering institution** 
 .
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience architecting and building
 **scalable technology products** 
 , preferably within technology startups or high\-growth product companies.
 



 • Proven experience with
 **N2N / B2B / B2C marketplaces, e\-commerce platforms or multi\-sided digital ecosystems** 
 .
 



 • Strong understanding of modern
 **cloud\-native architecture, APIs, microservices, databases and scalable distributed systems** 
 .
 



 • Practical experience designing or building products using
 **Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, machine learning or AI\-driven automation** 
 .
 



 • Ability to think simultaneously as a
 **Product Architect, Software Engineer and Technology Innovator** 
 .
 



 • Experience taking products from
 **concept → architecture → MVP → production → scale** 
 .
 



 Most importantly, you should still enjoy
 **building** 
 .
 



 We are not looking for someone whose role has become entirely managerial. We want a senior technologist who can define architecture, make critical engineering decisions, work with developers and remain close to the product and the code.
 



  





**Technology Stack \& AI\-Native Architecture** 




  






 We intend to build Goldfishh’s technology platform as a
 
**cloud\-native, API\-first, modular and AI\-native architecture designed for an Agentic AI future** 

 . The preferred technology ecosystem will include
 
**Python and TypeScript/Node.js** 

 , modern web frameworks such as
 
**React/Next.js** 

 ,
 
**PostgreSQL and NoSQL/vector databases** 

 , containerised microservices using
 
**Docker/Kubernetes** 

 , and scalable cloud infrastructure on
 
**AWS/Azure/GCP** 

 . The AI layer will leverage
 
**LLMs, multimodal models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, knowledge graphs, MCP, tool/function calling and multi\-agent orchestration frameworks** 

 , with the flexibility to work across leading foundation models and open\-source models rather than becoming dependent on a single AI provider. The architecture should enable autonomous AI Agents to securely interact with our
 
**futuristic N2N Marketplace, WMS, OMS, TMS, ERP, e\-commerce, logistics and external partner systems through APIs and event\-driven workflows** 

 . We are looking for an engineer who can help us make the right technology choices in discussion with the core team while designing an architecture capable of evolving towards
 
**AI Agents that can reason, plan, execute, collaborate and automate increasingly complex supply\-chain and commerce workflows.** 




  





**Why Goldfishh?** 




  





 Goldfishh is 6 year old Tech stratup building at the intersection of two enormous ecosystems:
 



**Physical Supply Chains × Digital Commerce.** 
 Our operating businesses across warehousing, 3PL, logistics and e\-commerce give us something particularly valuable for technology innovation:
 **Real customers. Real warehouses. Real inventory. Real transactions. Real operational problems to solve.** 




 Our ambition is to convert that operating experience into
 **disruptive, scalable technology products for the supply\-chain and commerce ecosystem.** 




  





**Our founding team comprises BITS Pilani / IIT alumni, bringing deep domain expertise, entrepreneurial experience and strong technology\-product DNA. We are now preparing for our first institutional VC fundraise to accelerate the next phase of growth.** 
 We deliberately stayed away from VC funding in our formative years—choosing to first build the business, prove the model, acquire customers and generate revenues. Now, we believe the time is right to scale with external capital.
 



  





 This is an opportunity for someone who wants to look back a few years from now and say:
 



**“I helped architect and build that from Day One.”** 




**This role could be right for you if…** 




 You have spent years building technology products, but your next chapter is not about joining another large engineering organisation.
 



 You want
 **ownership, experimentation, speed and the opportunity to create something genuinely new.** 




 If that sounds interesting, we would like to talk.
 



  





**Experience:** 
 10–15\+ years
 



**Domain:** 
 SaaS \| Marketplaces \| E\-Commerce \| Supply Chain \| AI
 



**Education:** 
 BE / BTech or equivalent, preferably from a premier engineering institution
 



**Company:** 
 Goldfishh Supply Chain Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Website:** 
 www.goldfishh.com

title: Associate, Reconciliations
description:
**About This Role**
 The Outsourced Platform Services Asset Reconciliations team is responsible for delivering a robust reconciliation operating model that safeguards the integrity of BlackRock’s investment data across critical processes, including investment management, analytics, compliance, and regulatory reporting. The team oversees reconciliation across a broad range of asset classes, including equities, fixed income, derivatives, collateral, and related cash activity, partnering closely with internal teams, external service providers, custodians, and clients to ensure timely resolution of exceptions and a strong control environment. The Associate is expected to develop a strong understanding of reconciliation processes, exception management, root\-cause analysis, risk identification, data analysis, and process improvement while contributing to a controlled and efficient operating environment.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities Include**
* Perform day\-to\-day reconciliation activities, including control reporting, position break resolution, inbox and dashboard monitoring, client and portfolio maintenance, and subscription/redemption processing.
* Deliver high\-quality service to internal and external stakeholders by addressing inquiries, performing controls, resolving issues, and mitigating operational risk.
* Prepare and review reconciliations across BlackRock, asset manager, and custodian records, investigating differences and resolving exceptions accurately and within required timelines.
* Maintain account and portfolio records to reflect client, account, and market\-driven changes accurately and on a timely basis.
* Partner with external service providers, internal teams, and other BlackRock functions to investigate and resolve operational issues.
* Support special projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing controls, improving service delivery, and increasing operational efficiency.
* Build strong working relationships with internal and external partners, with a focus on collaboration, responsiveness, and client service.
* Identify process inefficiencies and recommend enhancements to strengthen controls, improve scalability, and support standard methodologies.
* Raising all material risk items and service issues on a timely basis.
* Coaching and mentoring team members to encourage high individual performance and service standards
* Demonstrating ability to self\-improve and develop. Understand the impact of Position on upstream and downstream partners


**Skills Required**
* The ability to prioritize and balance multiple requests without losing sight of our overall objectives
* You possess strong decision\-making skills to make well\-thought\-out decisions based on the information provided and to obtain further assistance/clarification when vital
* You can multi\-task and perform in a high performance, high demand environment!
* You take the initiative to follow up on issues – identify what needs to be done and act
* Ability to multi\-task, balance multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced and evolving team
* You are organized and detail oriented with strong time management skills
* Ability to work in a multifaceted and team oriented environment and quickly adapt to a constantly evolving business
* Contributor to the leadership team ensuring appropriate staffing model, depth charts and succession plans are assessed across the location
* Do you have the social skills to effectively articulate solutions to internal and external partners?
* Capability to assist in creating a team vision, planning and executing steps to ensure a consistently robust team
* Thrive in a team environment and build strong relationships with colleagues and external contacts such as custodians, counterparties and other third\-party providers
* You have strong knowledge of equity and fixed income securities and derivative products
* You are proficient in Microsoft Office and have an aptitude for learning new applications!


**Preferred**
* A four\-year degree is required in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or Economics
* Understanding upstream processes is impactful to reconciliation and develop ability to correlate the effect of change
* Flexible and open to accepting new challenges; able to work effectively and efficiently on multiple projects at a time in a dynamic, demanding and constantly evolving environment while maintaining the highest standard and attention to detail


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Medical Laboratory Technician
description:
**Company Description** 
 Labridge is a rapidly growing B2B healthcare partner that builds and supports a strong network of diagnostic centers across India. The company offers competitive B2B rates for blood and RT\-PCR sample processing, along with integrated logistics, IT, and marketing support for partner laboratories. Through a dedicated marketplace, Labridge provides high\-quality consumables at cost\-effective prices to help labs operate efficiently. By prioritizing service excellence, fast turnaround times, and reliable reporting, Labridge enables diagnostic centers to scale, reduce operational costs, and improve patient care. title: RF System Design Engineer
description:
**We're Hiring: RF System Design Engineer** 




**Full\-Time \| Core Team** 




**RSKD Labs Private Limited \| Defence** 




  





 India has a coastline of more than 11,000 km, and the systems that watch over it shouldn't depend on anyone else. At RSKD Labs, we're building unmanned surface vessels (USVs) and the communications that make them useful: links that hold at sea, under pressure, when it matters most.
 



  





 A USV is only as capable as its link. If the link drops, the vessel is blind, deaf, and alone. The sea works against you constantly through multipath off the water, a platform that never stops moving, salt, spray, and an adversary who wants your spectrum. Our job is to make the link unbreakable anyway, carrying video, telemetry, and command traffic between vessels, shore, and command without flinching.
 



  





 That's the problem we're handing you. You'll own the RF chain from antenna to digitized samples. You'll prototype on SDRs, so an idea on Monday is transmitting over water by Friday. And because our architecture is software\-defined, every improvement you make ships to the whole fleet as new capability.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  




* The entire RF architecture for our USV datalinks, including frequency planning, link and power budgets, cascade, dynamic range, and spurious analysis. It's yours to design, defend, and prove at sea.
* Transmit and receive chains built to hold up in hard conditions: LO generation, synthesizers, PAs, LNAs, and filtering, with phase noise, linearity, and isolation driven down to component level
* A software\-defined communications stack with reconfigurable waveforms, sampling\-friendly front\-ends, and clean RF\-digital partitioning, so the system keeps getting better long after it leaves the dock
* Links that survive contested spectrum, using frequency hopping, anti\-jam techniques, interference mitigation, and adaptive modulation. Plan for the worst day.
* Antennas and RF front\-ends for platforms that pitch, roll, and heave, including omni, directional, and steerable or stabilized designs
* Mastery of over\-sea propagation: multipath fading, sea\-state variation, ducting, and horizon limits. You'll understand them well enough to turn them to our advantage.
* Multi\-node and mesh networks that tie USVs, relays, and shore stations into one resilient system
* The loop that matters: simulate, build, measure, correlate, iterate. Hardware has the final say.
* Test campaigns from the lab to the harbour to open sea, ending in live multi\-vessel trials
* Hardware that survives the ocean's abuse (thermal, vibration, shock, water ingress, salt fog, EMI/EMC), documented to production\-grade standards



  





**Who You Are** 




  




* You've done hands\-on RF system design in defence electronics, tactical communications, or datalinks. Experience limited to commercial telecom or 5G won't be enough on its own; we need people who've designed for adversarial conditions.
* You've taken at least one complete RF system from architecture through hardware to the field, and you know the gap between a simulation and reality.
* You understand wireless links deeply: modulation, coding, synchronization, and every RF impairment that tries to break them.
* You design antennas at element level, ideally arrays or steerable systems too, and you're fluent in UHF, L, S, or C band (X/Ku a plus).
* Link budgets, cascades, frequency plans, spur charts, and phase\-noise budgets are second nature to you.
* You work confidently in EM simulation (HFSS, CST, FEKO, AWR) and circuit or system simulation (ADS, Microwave Office, SystemVue).
* You're at home in the lab with a VNA, spectrum analyzer, signal generators, phase\-noise analyzers, and power meters.
* You've built with SDR platforms (e.g., USRP, AD9361/AD9371\-class transceivers).
* You script your analysis and automation in MATLAB or Python.
* Bonus points for SATCOM or BLOS links, mesh networking, anti\-jam or LPI/LPD waveforms, or marine and naval hardware qualification.
* Most importantly, "I haven't done this before" is where you start, not where you stop.



  





**Why RSKD Labs?** 




  




* **Build what the nation needs.** 
 Sovereign maritime defence technology, designed and built in India from first principles.
* **Own it from day one.** 
 This is a core team role with real authority over real architecture.
* **See it at sea.** 
 Your work leaves the lab and proves itself on the water, fast.



  





 The sea doesn't care how good your slides are. If you want to build links that hold when everything else is trying to break them, we want to hear from you.

title: Senior Associate- IT Infra & Security
description:
The Senior Associate will be responsible for managing and strengthening the organization’s
 **information security, Google Workspace environment, endpoint ecosystem, and core IT infrastructure** 
 . The role will support secure and reliable day\-to\-day technology operations, including the Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace migration, endpoint security, infrastructure management, compliance, incident response, vulnerability management, and technology improvements.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 1\. IT Infrastructure \& Operations
 


* Plan, implement, maintain, and monitor
 **LAN/WAN, Wi\-Fi, internet connectivity, servers, switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs, and other network infrastructure** 
 .
* Ensure availability, performance, scalability, and security of critical IT infrastructure and systems.
* Troubleshoot and resolve escalated hardware, software, network, internet, endpoint, and system\-related issues.
* Establish and maintain monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices.
* Manage infrastructure vendors, AMC/support contracts, licenses, and technology partners.
* Support infrastructure upgrades, office IT deployments, and technology migrations.



  





 2\. Endpoint Management \& Security
 


* Manage the lifecycle of
 **Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS devices** 
 , including enrollment, configuration, patching, application deployment, inventory, compliance monitoring, and secure decommissioning.
* Manage MDM/UEM, EDR, antivirus, anti\-malware, firewall, disk encryption, device\-control, and endpoint compliance solutions.

* Implement controls for removable media, local administration, browser security, application installation, and data transfer.
* Maintain accurate endpoint and asset records and establish secure onboarding, role\-change, offboarding, data\-removal, and device\-lifecycle processes.



  





 3\. Security Operations, DLP \& Incident Response
 


* Conduct security posture assessments and review security policies, configurations, risks, and remediation actions.
* Implement and manage
 **DLP controls across email, web, cloud applications, and endpoints** 
 .
* Investigate DLP alerts and continuously refine security rules while minimizing false positives.
* Handle escalated security incidents, including phishing, compromised accounts, malware, endpoint compromise, and suspected data leakage.
* Coordinate incident containment, investigation, root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
* Work with internal teams and security partners to strengthen the organization's overall security posture.



  





 4\. Google Workspace Administration \& Security
 


* Administer
 **Google Workspace** 
 , including users, Organizational Units, groups, domains, Shared Drives, licenses, administrative roles, Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Meet, Groups, and Google Vault.
* Configure and manage
 **MFA, SSO, RBAC, access controls, external\-sharing restrictions, retention policies, email security, audit logging, security alerts, investigation tools, eDiscovery, and legal holds** 
 .
* Support and manage the
 **Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace migration** 
 , including user migration, security configuration, access management, troubleshooting, and post\-migration stabilization.
* Conduct periodic reviews of privileged access, inactive accounts, external sharing, security configurations, and overall Workspace security posture.
* Resolve escalated administration, access, email delivery, and Google Workspace security issues.



  





 5\. VAPT, Vulnerability Management \& Compliance
 


* Coordinate
 **VAPT activities** 
 , including scope definition, access requirements, schedules, rules of engagement, evidence collection, remediation, retesting, and closure.
* Maintain vulnerability and risk registers and track remediation across endpoints, networks, servers, cloud platforms, and applications.
* Support
 **ISO 27001, internal, customer, and regulatory audits** 
 .
* Coordinate evidence collection, control testing, risk assessments, non\-conformities, corrective actions, and compliance documentation.
* Support continuous improvement of IT security policies, procedures, and controls.



  





 6\. VDI, Infrastructure Projects \& Vendor Management
 


* Support secure and reliable office networks, servers, storage, backups, recovery readiness, and infrastructure upgrades.
* Evaluate and support implementation of
 **VDI and secure\-access solutions** 
 for remote work and BYOD environments.
* Assess solutions based on identity, data protection, device isolation, performance, scalability, security, and user experience.
* Coordinate technology vendors and service providers for evaluation, procurement, implementation, maintenance, escalations, and Proof of Concepts (POCs).

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics CRM Technical Senior Specialized:**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Lead / Senior Consultant to design, deliver, and optimize enterprise\-grade D365 and Power Platform solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise with solution ownership, team leadership, and stakeholder engagement to drive business outcomes across complex CRM environments.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design, development, configuration, and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions aligned with business requirements and best practices.
* Architect and deliver end\-to\-end solutions across D365 modules including Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service.
* Develop and customize CRM components such as entities, forms, views, dashboards, workflows, plugins, and integrations.
* Build custom solutions using C\#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Dynamics 365 SDK, and Web API.
* Design and implement scalable integrations using Azure and Power Platform capabilities.
* Oversee system architecture, performance tuning, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment to ensure optimal functionality and user experience.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to team members, fostering collaboration and high\-quality delivery.
* Engage with business and technical stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear and actionable discussions.
* Participate in project planning, sprint ceremonies, estimations, and delivery governance using Agile methodologies.
* Stay current with Dynamics 365 and Power Platform advancements, recommending continuous improvements.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM configuration, customization, and solution delivery.
* Proficiency in C\#, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS with hands\-on experience in plugins and workflows.
* Solid knowledge of Power Platform including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.
* Strong understanding of CRM data models, security, and business processes.
* Experience designing scalable, maintainable system architectures.
* Proven problem\-solving and analytical skills with attention to quality and performance.
* Effective communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Ability to work independently while thriving in collaborative, Agile teams.
* Developed and customized AI Copilots and agents using Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365 CRM, integrating workflows, Dataverse, and APIs to support intelligent automation and conversational experiences.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
 The following skills and experiences are preferred and will be considered an advantage:
   

  

* Power Pages
* Canvas Apps and Model\-Driven Apps (Code Apps)
* PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) Controls
* Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus
* Data Migration using SSIS (KingswaySoft) and Azure Data Factory
* Copilot Studio
* Dynamics 365 Project Operations
* Dynamics 365 Field Service
* Dynamics 365 Contact Center


**What We Look For**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM development and implementation.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments (Scrum/Kanban).
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Power Platform certifications are preferred.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trusted client and stakeholder relationships.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Project Role Description :** 
 Configure and support packaged or SaaS applications to adapt features, manage releases, and ensure system stability. Use standard tools, APIs, and low\-code platforms to align solutions with business needs while preserving compatibility and performance.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Wealth Management Advisory Solutions

**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**

The role includes managing application releases and ensuring the overall stability and performance of the system. The engineer works with various tools, application programming interfaces, and low\-code platforms to deliver solutions that align with organizational goals while maintaining compatibility across different environments.  Must Have Skills
   

  

 3\+ years of experience in the Wealth Management domain.
   

  

 Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience with Test Master Automation
   

  

 Understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
   

  

 Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
   

  

 Knowledge of defect management and test management processes.
   

  

 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

 Good to Have
   

  

 Experience in test reporting, dashboards, and metrics analysis.
   

  

 Exposure to application testing and quality engineering practices.
   

  

 Knowledge of JIRA, Azure DevOps, or similar project management tools.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 Minimum 5\+ years of overall professional experience.
   

  

 At least 5 years of experience in Wealth Management projects.
   

  

 At least 5 years of Test Master experience.
   

  

 Location: Mumbai/ Pune .
   

  

 15 years of full\-time education required.

title: Digital Strategist
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Our Digital Experience suite of products is market\-leading in the Enterprise Digital Marketing space, and we have had terrific success globally with major brands. Our focus on the success of our customers is central to our Professional Services business strategy, and we need creative, proactive Senior Digital Marketeers who have the skills, experience, and track record to work with our customers across industries and digital channels, to lead, drive value realisation and business impact!
   

  

 Are you a Digital Strategist who combines business acumen and innovative digital marketing know\-how, with operational expertise to build outstanding and impactful experiences for our customer’s customer.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 A value led Consultant responsible for the realisation of tangible business impact for our customers, the design and implementation of processes to drive operational efficiencies, whilst implementing a culture of innovation, and fostering creativity to unlock new opportunities for your customers and Adobe Consulting.
   

  

 Lead inspiring business discovery workstreams, and perform industry and customer research to establish the customer’s ‘why’.
   

  

 Lead \& execute Data driven Marketing for Customer Journeys \& Campaigns:
   

  

 Maximise digital adoption: Utilise data to proactively analyse opportunities and identify customer journeys \& consumer behaviours that can be influenced to drive Adobe’s digital impact.
   

  

 Directly engage clients to improve \& understand their as\-is Customer segmentations, have a specialist’s focus on optimisation \& personalisation across Marketing channels
   

  

 Improve \& monetize Customer Journeys \& Marketing Campaign Performance: Analyse and Recommend how to make Journeys \& Campaigns more effective via UX changes, CX changes, A/B Tests, etc.
   

  

 Work with client to enable them to understand and leverage Marketing Data Collection Strategy to best leverage Adobe solutions
   

  

 Ideation, Planning, Delivery, Measurement \& Optimization of Experience Cloud use cases, their associated customer benefits and how to measure them.
   

  

 Work with Client teams \& Stakeholders to identify Business Requirements, KPIs to capture: as Documentation – BRDs, Journey Understanding documents
   

  

 Develop effective customers partnerships (Senior levels) to align on business goals, critical metrics and future state thinking
   

  

 Create dashboards for management reporting, insights and/or problem analysis.
   

  

 Identify trends and industry examples that support the creation of impactful use cases that bring a customer’s business goals to life.
   

  

 Play \& think like an end consumer / Customer to enable Product UATs and feedback cycle.
   

  

 Research and define customer personas and build ideal state customer journey maps.
   

  

 Build customer roadmaps, develop, and lead execution of the tactical plans to implement the next phase of the roadmap.
   

  

 Design and implement processes \& ways of working to drive operational efficiencies.
   

  

 Coordinate the execution of marketing activities by Adobe teams or customer teams.
   

  

 Design and implement the measurement frameworks needed to monitor, optimise and report on tangible business outcomes for the Customer.
   

  

 Support the evolution and optimisation of practice artefacts, be an active and engaged member of the Business consulting community.
   

  

 Inform the evolution of our go to market and represent our group and services credibly and effectively in pre\-sales scenarios, and on external platforms.
   

  

 Mentor, support and collaborate with your peers to scale your expertise and influence.
   

  

 What You'll Need To Succeed
   

  

 A leader and brand ambassador, who is passionate about current digital marketing trends and has extensive experience translating digital strategy into marketing tactics to deliver exceptional CX!
   

  

 A strong eye for business, and deep experience within a core industry (e.g., Banking \& Financial Services, Telecom \& media, Retail, Travel etc.), with the ability to balance multiple assignments across teams in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Willingness to learn and ramp up quickly. This includes new tools, business processes and deliverables.
   

  

 Willingness to travel and be client facing \& engaging.
   

  

 Data Analysis: Extensive knowledge in how data shapes and drives the customer experience across platforms and channels. You have demonstrated experience analysing website and audience data to uncover insights.
   

  

 Customer Persona and Journey Development: Extensive experience building personas and customer journeys aligned to these. Data / audience strategy development expertise.
   

  

 Experience in Customer product management and defining product\-based value
   

  

 Conversion Rate Optimisation: Understand and anticipate customer needs, build testing \& personalisation roadmaps, advise on and build audience \& customer segments, guide on data to collect and use, and implement tests for statistical results through multiple channels
   

  

 Experience in running Marketing Tests and Run program: A/B testing
   

  

 Campaign Planning and Workflow Management w.r.t customer journey management.
   

  

 Experience conducting successful client workshops involving senior\-levels
   

  

 6\+ years' experience successfully engaging clients within the digital world ideally.
   

  

 Digital Product Experience: using one or more industry leading Analytics, Testing, Personalisation, Journey \& Campaign products / tools, e.g., Adobe or similar competitors. Experience of working on Adobe Solutions (Analytics, Target, Campaign) will be an advantage.
   

  

 A self\-starter, bold and proactive, able to gain the trust of customers and internal teams. You might work independently and as part of a team.
   

  

 Proficient use of power point presentations to socialise realised business outcomes internally and externally and develop customer success stories.
   

  

 Outstanding problem\-solving skills and analytical skills
   

  

 Excellent interpersonal, and presentation skills both verbal and written.
   

  

**About Adobe**
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
   

  

 Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
   

  

**Let’s Adobe together**
 At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
   

  

 Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
   

  

 Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.
   

  

**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**
 Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

description:
**Business Strategy Manager** 




 at Traya Health
 



  





  





**Location:** 
**Mumbai** 




  





**About the Company** 
 :
 



 Founded in 2019, Traya is one of India's largest digital health\-tech platforms for haircare and hair loss. Our mission is to use technology to scale healthcare solutions to 520M\+ Indians that are suffering from hair loss with a holistic 360\-degree solution, which includes clinically proven, doctor\-backed medicines, access to Traya doctors, personal hair coach, customized diet plans, and more!
 



  





 Founded by Saloni Anand, a techie\-turned\-marketeer and Altaf Saiyed, a Stanford Business School alumnus, Traya sits at the forefront of the multi\-billion\-dollar hair care solutions category
 **.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Experimentation Engine: Design and run cross\-functional experiments across product, tech, ops, and marketing with clear hypotheses, guardrails, and success criteria; institutionalize rapid learn\-decide\-scale cycles.
* Product \& Tech for Revenue: Prioritize features and internal tools that improve acquisition, conversion, retention, and monetization; ensure instrumentation, data integrity, and experiment frameworks are in place.
* Growth Strategy \& Category Expansion: Identify high\-impact levers across segments, offerings, geographies, and partnerships; build business cases and translate them into a focused execution roadmap.
* Own Revenue : Set the growth thesis, define north\-star and input KPIs, and run a tight operating cadence to scale up business.
* Marketing Efficiency \& Portfolio Mix: Orchestrate channel strategy and lifecycle communication to maximize incremental revenue at optimal spend efficiency; allocate budgets dynamically based on impact.
* Ops \& CX Alignment: Align capacity, SLAs, and processes to convert demand reliably; drive throughput, reduce leakage and churn, and ensure the customer experience supports sustained revenue growth.
* Insights, Forecasting \& Governance: Build dashboards, cohort and funnel views, and forward forecasts; lead RCA to focus on the highest\-ROI bets; codify learnings into a repeatable revenue playbook and manage stakeholders to adopt it
 **.**



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* 2\-5 years of Proven experience in business strategy, Growth, Category Management or founder's office roles within startups or high\-growth environments.
* Education: B.Tech (Tier 1 ) or MBA (TIER 1\)
* Strong business acumen and the ability to connect market insights to actionable strategies.
* Demonstrated success in designing, validating, and executing growth initiatives.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills with a data\-driven approach.
* Strong leadership, communication, and collaboration skills to influence stakeholders across levels.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, evolving environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Experience: Relevant experience in consulting, corporate strategy, or startup strategy

title: Consumer Engagement Associate
description:
At AMINU, marketing is not just about sending a message or creating a campaign. It’s about
 
**understanding our consumers, listening to what they need, and building meaningful conversations** 

 that make them want to stay connected with the brand..
 





 You’ll get the opportunity to
 
**work closely with AMINU’s co\-founders** 

 , seek guidance from them and learn how decisions are made in a growing premium brand. You’ll also get first\-hand exposure to how
 
**premium consumers think, communicate and interact with a brand** 

 —and what it takes to build trust and loyalty with them.
 




  





**Why This Role is the Future** 





 Luxury retail in India is evolving rapidly, and AMINU is building at the forefront of this space. This role gives you the opportunity to understand how a premium Indian brand builds relationships with its consumers, not just how it sells to them.
 




  






 You’ll start by speaking to consumers directly, understanding their questions, expectations, behaviour and purchase decisions. As you grow, you’ll move from understanding conversations to building communication strategies across WhatsApp, email, AI, CRM and other consumer touchpoints.
 




  






 Step 1 is about learning the consumer. Step 2 is about learning how to communicate with them.
 




  






 By the end of the journey, you should be able to look at a consumer segment and think about what they need to hear, how AMINU should say it, where we should say it and how we know if it worked.
 




  






 The goal is to give you a foundation in consumer psychology, luxury communication and retention strategy and eventually enable you to contribute to how AMINU builds its relationship with consumers.
 




  




**What You'll Do** 

**Consumer Experience \& ORM** 




**Stage 1:** 



* Handle consumer conversations across WhatsApp, Instagram and email around skincare, products, orders, shipments and offers.
* Understand consumer concerns, analyse conversations and identify patterns and insights.
* Create customer\-facing creatives, copy and communication to educate and assist consumers.



**Stage 2:** 



* Train and improve
 
**AI\-powered customer communication bots** 

 and response flows



**CRM \& Retention** 




**Stage 1:** 



* Write copy, build audience segments and work with the creative team on campaign assets.
* Build and test customer journeys such as
 
**welcome, post\-purchase, restock and checkout abandonment** 

 .



**Stage 2:** 



* Track campaign performance and use learnings to improve future communication.
* Plan and execute end to end WhatsApp, email and SMS campaigns.



**Conversion \& Growth** 




**Stage 1:** 



* Conduct personalised customer calls and basic skin consultations.
* Analyse customer behaviour and audit website journeys to identify conversion opportunities..
* Share consumer insights with the marketing team to improve campaigns and communication.



**Stage 2:** 



* Identify opportunities for
 
**upselling, cross\-selling and improving AOV**



**﻿**



**How You'll Grow** 

**Month 1–2:** 

 Learn AMINU, our products, consumers and brand voice. Handle consumer conversations and understand our customer journey.
 




**Month 3–4:** 

 Start building campaigns, writing copy, creating segments and contributing to analysis and AI bot training.
 




**Month 5–6:** 

 Own complete campaigns and customer journeys, analyse performance and contribute to CRM and retention strategy.
 




**Beyond the internship:** 

 High performers can grow into a
 
**full\-time CRM \& Retention / Consumer Engagement role** 

 , owning campaigns, customer journeys and retention initiatives.
 




  





**Details** 




**This job opening is for freshers or people up\-to 1 year of experience**

 Kandivali West, Mumbai (In\-office)

**Timings:**

title: Contact Center Technology Engineer
description:
Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, ideas\-led environment, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in\-office.**
**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
 This position is responsible for managing a variety of tasks supporting the overall contact center technology ecosystem including phone \& messaging platforms, IVR, and reporting. This individual must monitor system uptime, conduct periodic testing, investigate technology issues, plan, design, track, and modify IVR\-enabled telecommunications systems using Amazon Connect or similar technologies.
   

  

**In This Role You Will Get To**
* Technical Acumen – Manage various contact center configurations including: IVR \& ACD (Amazon Connect/AWS DynamoDb, Lambda,S3, Cloudwatch/logs), Contact Control Panel (CCP), API integrations, QA, QM, WFM platforms (Verint or equivalent), troubleshooting IVR issues, etc.
* Fortify \& Optimize – Support remote contact center teams globally that depend on stable technology platforms to facilitate customer interactions and agent transaction processing. Seek opportunities to secure/harden the contact center infrastructure and improve the proactive monitoring of critical components. Ensure the quality of contact center service in terms of stability, performance, and cost effectiveness.
* Vendor Engagement – Facilitate discussions with outsource partners and contact center technology vendors (Verint, Amazon and other leading contact center tools ) to achieve business objectives.
* Analytics – Analyze metrics on platform/system performance to ensure uptime requirements are met. Continually review and make recommendations to the business on ways technology can be leveraged to improve the customer experience and/or maximize operational efficiency.
* Incident Management \- Assist with efforts related to service restoration and root cause analysis. Work through outsource partner counterparts to remedy service degradations and develop proper preventive measures as needed to prevent future service failures. Manage day to day technology issues/concerns at our contact centers globally.


**Who You Are**
* 3\+ years in technology or a related field.
* Direct experience with AWS and Amazon Connect/AWS DynamoDb, Lambda,S3, Cloudwatch/logs) is a plus
* Exposure with enterprise\-scale IVR
* A basic understanding of programming languages and machine learning concepts preferred.
* Familiarity with voice and data networking.
* Prior call center operations experience is preferred.
* Previous experience in the travel / hospitality industry is considered an asset.
* Effectively communicate with individuals at all levels internally and externally.
* Solid analytical, follow\-up, and organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to operate successfully in a time\-sensitive and fast\-paced contact center environment,
* Access Management, Troubleshooting and remediation of tech issues reported at our contact centers.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.


**Who We Are**
 WE ARE PRICELINE.
   

  

 Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding \- we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
   

  

 Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown\-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
   

  

 We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
   

  

 Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
   

  

 If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
   

  

**Flexible work at Priceline**
 Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
   

  

**Diversity and Inclusion are a Big Deal!**
 To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, it’s important we have a workforce that reflects the diverse customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
   

  

 Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love you to join us and add to our rich mix!
   

  

**Applying for this position**
 We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all
 **current employees** 
 , please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.
   

  

 External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

**Personal Attributes**

description:
Job Title: Regional Manager
   

  

 Department: Operations / Business Development
   

 Location: Mumbai \& Delhi
   

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

 Experience: 5–10 Years
   

  

 Job Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented Regional Manager to oversee clinic operations, business growth, team performance, patient experience, and revenue targets across the assigned region.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 1\. Clinic Growth \& Business Performance
   

  

 \- Take ownership of clinic growth and performance across the assigned region.
   

 \- Drive monthly revenue, patient base, conversion, and other defined KPIs.
   

 \- Analyse clinic\-wise performance and identify gaps and opportunities.
   

 \- Develop strategies to improve patient footfall, conversions, repeat visits, and productivity.
   

 \- Conduct regular performance reviews and create improvement plans for underperforming clinics.
   

  

 2\. Clinic Operations \& Issue Resolution
   

  

 \- Ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations across assigned clinics.
   

 \- Act as the first point of escalation for operational challenges.
   

 \- Coordinate with central teams to resolve issues within defined timelines.
   

 \- Ensure adherence to SOPs, processes, and service standards.
   

 \- Identify recurring issues and implement preventive measures.
   

  

 3\. Team Management \& Performance
   

  

 \- Manage and guide front desk and clinic support teams.
   

 \- Set clear expectations and ensure accountability.
   

 \- Conduct regular team reviews, coaching, and performance discussions.
   

 \- Identify manpower and capability gaps and coordinate for resolution.
   

 \- Build a culture of ownership, discipline, patient\-centricity, and target orientation.
   

  

 4\. Patient Journey Management
   

  

 \- Oversee the complete patient journey from enquiry and appointment through consultation, treatment, billing, and follow\-up.
   

 \- Track patient movement and identify drop\-offs.
   

 \- Ensure timely patient follow\-ups.
   

 \- Monitor and resolve patient feedback and complaints.
   

 \- Improve patient retention, repeat visits, and overall satisfaction.
   

  

 5\. Follow\-up \& Patient Conversion
   

  

 \- Monitor patient follow\-up processes and conversion metrics.
   

 \- Ensure systematic tracking of pending leads, enquiries, missed appointments, and follow\-ups.
   

 \- Identify gaps in follow\-up processes and train teams accordingly.
   

 \- Ensure potential patient opportunities are not lost due to delayed follow\-up.
   

  

 6\. Front Desk Training \& Capability Building
   

  

 \- Conduct regular training and on\-the\-job coaching for front desk teams.
   

 \- Train staff on patient handling, communication, appointment management, follow\-ups, counselling coordination, and escalation handling.
   

 \- Ensure teams understand clinic targets and their contribution to business performance.
   

  

 7\. Stock \& Inventory Management
   

  

 \- Monitor inventory and stock availability across assigned clinics.
   

 \- Ensure timely availability of consumables, supplements, and other clinic requirements.
   

 \- Track consumption, movement, replenishment, and wastage.
   

 \- Coordinate with central/supply teams to prevent stock\-outs.
   

 \- Ensure proper stock records and adherence to inventory processes.
   

  

 8\. Patient Footfall \& Central Team Coordination
   

  

 \- Coordinate with central marketing and business teams to drive patient footfall.
   

 \- Share clinic\-level requirements, market insights, and performance feedback.
   

 \- Track the effectiveness of footfall\-generation initiatives.
   

 \- Ensure clinics are prepared to handle generated patient volumes.
   

  

 9\. New Tie\-ups \& Business Development
   

  

 \- Identify and develop new business opportunities and local tie\-ups.
   

 \- Explore referral channels, healthcare professionals, institutions, corporates, and communities.
   

 \- Build relationships with doctors and healthcare professionals for referral opportunities.
   

 \- Identify local market opportunities that can contribute to clinic growth.
   

  

 10\. Reporting \& Performance Reviews
   

  

 \- Monitor and report clinic\-wise:
   

 \- Revenue and target achievement
   

 \- Patient footfall
   

 \- Conversion performance
   

 \- Follow\-up performance
   

 \- Repeat patients
   

 \- Operational issues
   

 \- Stock status
   

 \- Team performance
   

 \- Patient feedback
   

 \- Provide regular updates and actionable insights to senior management.
   

 \- Use data and performance trends to identify gaps and take corrective action.
   

  

 Travel Requirement
   

  

 \- 15–20 days of travel per month across the assigned region.
   

 \- Regular clinic visits to review operations, meet teams, assess patient experience, monitor performance, and drive growth initiatives.
   

 \- Travel may also be required for business development, local tie\-ups, and referral partnerships.
   

  

 Candidate Profile
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 \- 5–10 years of experience in clinic operations, healthcare, wellness, hospitals, diagnostics, retail healthcare, or a similar multi\-location service business.
   

 \- Experience managing multiple locations/clinics will be preferred.
   

 \- Proven experience in achieving business/clinic targets and managing frontline teams.
   

  

 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

 \- Strong business and growth orientation
   

 \- Excellent people management and leadership skills
   

 \- Strong operational and problem\-solving abilities
   

 \- Patient/customer\-centric approach
   

 \- Good communication and interpersonal skills
   

 \- Ability to analyse performance data and take corrective action
   

 \- Strong follow\-up and execution discipline
   

 \- Effective coordination with central and clinic\-level teams
   

 \- Relationship\-building and local business development skills
   

 \- Comfortable with extensive travel

title: Executive Assistant
description:
"The founders’ right hand. You keep their world running and help shape what comes next — partexecutive assistant, part strategic partner, always in the room."
 



  





**About Glassbox** 




 Glassbox is a global strategic consultancy focused on empowering challenger brands. Founded by industry veterans in consulting and brand\-building, Glassbox operates on the belief that a challenger brand challenges the status quo, not just competitors. We leverage data science, media strategy, creative positioning, and design thinking to create meaningful connections between brands and consumers. In 2026, Glassbox entered an exciting new chapter with its acquisition by Komerz Limited (UK). Now part of a global group operating across Europe, Asia, and North America, Glassbox is revolutionizing how brands are built — pairing its brand transformation expertise with commerce technology to take brands from awareness all the way to performance measurement. Our mission remains unchanged: to build ideal ecosystems for brands to thrive, with a holistic, sustainable, and purpose\-driven approach to brand building.
 



  





**The mandate** 




 You will be the founders' right hand and the operational spine of the founder's office. You will own their time, their inbox, their schedule, and their follow\-throughs — making sure the founders are always prepared, on time, and focused on what matters most. This is the core of the role, and getting it right is what earns trust. Beyond the executive\-assistant core, you will sit in on key meetings and pitches, support the projects that shape the organisation's growth, and act as the connective tissue between the founders and the rest of the business. You will also work closely with the Admin manager to keep office, travel, and operational logistics running smoothly. It is a high\-trust, high\-exposure role — discretion is non\-negotiable, priorities shift with the business, and the expectation is that you anticipate needs and stay two steps ahead.
 



  





**What you will own** 




 • The founders' time. Own calendars, scheduling, and prioritisation across competing demands. Protect deep\-work time and make sure the founders are always in the right room at the right time, fully prepped.
 



 • Inbox and communications. Manage and triage the founders' inbox, draft and respond on their behalf, and make sure nothing slips through the cracks.
 



 • Travel and logistics. Plan and coordinate travel, meetings, and events end to end — itineraries, bookings, and every on\-ground detail.

 ·       Build forecasting models for revenue, acquisition, retention and marketing spends.

 ·       Lead internal teams and external agencies/vendors across growth, CRM, performance and partnerships.

 ·       Track traffic, conversion and revenue from organic and emerging search surfaces.
