title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**About Beacon Platform By CWAN**
 Beacon is a cloud\-native, cross\-asset risk analytics and quantitative development platform used by top\-tier asset managers and banks. It provides a transparent, extensible environment for building, deploying and scaling valuation models, pricing libraries and risk analytics across asset classes — including derivatives, structured products and fixed income. It combines pre\-built financial applications with a flexible developer infrastructure that lets quants and model developers write custom pricing and valuation logic, run scenario analysis, and integrate models directly into front\-office and risk workflows.
   

  

 The role
   

  

* You will own the reliability of Clearwater's risk and analytics applications in engineering terms — designing and building the automation, tooling and operational architecture that keeps the overnight and intraday pipelines correct and on time for asset managers and insurers who need to see their portfolios each morning.
* This is a senior engineering role on the application layer. The distinction that matters at this level: you are expected to retire classes of failure, not instances of them. When the same problem appears for the third time, we want the engineer who stops patching it and builds the thing that makes it impossible to fail. That work competes for time with the model and feature changes the quant and risk teams are asking for, so you will also need to argue for it in their terms — what the recurring failure is costing them now, and what fixing it properly buys them. Cloud fluency matters because the applications run on AWS and you need to operate them competently there, but you will not be provisioning the infrastructure beneath them.
* You will be based in Mumbai alongside the market data team — a group with front\-office training who partner on the genuinely hard analytics questions, not only on data plumbing. That adjacency is the point of the placement: you will sit with the quant, risk and market data teams and be expected to learn what the systems actually compute. When a curve build fails or an end\-of\-day risk run finishes late, we want engineers who can reason about which clients are affected and what the number means.
* The team is part of a globally distributed platform organisation spanning Mumbai, Tokyo and the US, with US\-based coverage for the London close, so every major market cutoff falls inside a staffed window. You will join and help shape a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation covering the end\-of\-day cycles of multiple regions. We are explicit about this because the three\-region model is what keeps it sustainable — there is no permanent night shift.
* You will have real ownership of the services you support and direct influence over how reliability is engineered into them. You will report to the support lead in Mumbai.


 What you'll do
   

  

 Design and build the tooling layer
   

  

* Own the diagnostic tooling strategy — including AI\-assisted tooling — so that establishing whether an issue is infrastructure or market data, and which clients it touches, takes seconds rather than a manual trawl through logs and jobs. Tooling, not documentation alone, is how we intend to get response times down.
* Write and review production\-quality Python that eliminates toil: runbook automation, health checks, self\-service diagnostics and remediation used across the team.
* Design automated recovery and self\-healing for analytics jobs, so a single failed task does not become a missed client deliverable.
* Set the observability standard — design monitoring and alerting around business outcomes (late valuations, missing risk measures, stale prices) rather than host and container metrics, and drive alert noise down so pages are actionable and rare.


 Own production and lead incidents
   

  

* Own incident response for client\-impacting issues: command the incident, mitigate, communicate, and run blameless postmortems that end in fixes rather than findings.
* Investigate at the application level — logs, stack traces, job histories and the code itself — to establish root cause, then fix it or hand the development team a diagnosis precise enough to act on.
* Track service commitments and recurring pain: report on timeliness and failure trends, and push through the fixes that retire repeat issues.
* Set the boundary for first\-line infrastructure work — stale hosts, memory pressure, connectivity failures, host loss — so routine cases are remediated locally and deeper platform work escalates cleanly.


 Harden the batch and end\-of\-day architecture
   

  

* Own and harden large\-scale batch and EOD processing: job orchestration, dependency management, retries, idempotency, backfills and safe reruns.
* Keep the overnight window on schedule — find where time is going across stages and drive the fixes with the development teams.


 Own the data and market data interface
   

  

* Support the reference data, market data and timeseries stores behind pricing and risk — schema and index design, replication, retention and query performance in NoSQL and timeseries systems.
* Operate data quality and reconciliation controls with the market data team: completeness checks, stale\-data and anomaly alerting, vendor feed failure handling.
* Debug data\-shaped production problems — a missing fixing, a bad identifier mapping, a holiday calendar difference, a failed download job, a partial vendor file — traced through to the affected downstream analytics.
* Act as a single escalation path with the market data team on front\-office\-facing issues, sharing triage and root cause rather than passing tickets between functions.


 Lead and influence
   

  

* Partner with quant developers and risk engineers to make reliability a design input rather than a post\-launch concern.
* Mentor engineers on incident triage, investigation technique and on\-call practice, and set the standards for automation and operational readiness.
* Contribute to production readiness reviews for new services and client onboardings.
* Support client escalations on risk and analytics output, and be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Document architecture, runbooks and failure modes.


 What you'll bring
   

  

**Required**
* 7\+ years in software engineering for a business\-critical platform, with real ownership of services.
* Strong Python, plus shell. You must be comfortable reading and debugging application code to find root cause — this role is not runbook execution.
* Demonstrated troubleshooting depth — working from a vague client symptom through logs, job histories, data and code to a precise diagnosis.
* Hands\-on experience operating batch and scheduled workloads at scale, including workflow orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, Step Functions or equivalent).
* Solid grounding in distributed systems — you can reason about partial failure, retries, idempotency, consistency, and queue and backpressure behaviour under load.
* Working knowledge of AWS — enough to operate applications confidently (compute, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, basic networking) and to tell an infrastructure problem from an application one.
* Practical NoSQL experience (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra or similar): data modelling, indexing, replication and performance troubleshooting.
* Observability in practice — Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry or equivalent — and sensible alert design.
* On\-call experience with structured escalation and postmortem writing, and the judgement to lead an incident rather than only participate in one.
* A general understanding of financial systems and genuine appetite to learn the business. You should be able to hold a conversation about what a valuation or a risk number is for, and be willing to go deeper.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively in a globally distributed team.
* Degree (B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA / MSc) in computer science, engineering or a related field.


**Preferred**
* Experience with timeseries data at scale — storage and partitioning strategies, retention, and query patterns for large historical datasets.
* Experience supporting trading systems, order management systems, risk management systems or market data platforms.
* Familiarity with financial data concepts — instrument reference data, curves and fixings, corporate actions, EOD valuation cycles, VaR and sensitivities.
* Kubernetes and containerised workloads in production, from an operations perspective.
* Infrastructure as code and CI/CD — Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI — enough to make and review changes when the work calls for it.
* Streaming and event\-driven infrastructure (Kafka, Kinesis, MSK) and distributed compute (Spark, EMR, Dask, Ray).
* MongoDB Atlas, Redis / ElastiCache, or managed timeseries and analytical stores (Timestream, ClickHouse, Redshift).
* Working in a regulated financial environment — change management, access controls, audit evidence and client\-facing SLAs.
* Fluency with AI\-assisted development and operations tooling — using LLM\-based agents and assistants to build diagnostics, automate investigation and accelerate delivery.
* Experience mentoring engineers and setting operational standards across a team.


 What will make you stand out
   

  

* A track record of turning a fragile, hand\-held process into a stable service with measurably less manual intervention.
* Experience designing automated recovery, failover and monitoring specifically for analytics or compute\-heavy batch jobs.
* Tooling you built that measurably shortened time\-to\-diagnosis — and a view on where AI\-assisted tooling genuinely helps in an operations context and where it does not.
* The ability to translate a technical failure into client impact, and to be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Curiosity about the domain: engineers who ask what the model is doing and why the number matters build far better reliability into these systems.

 **funding, credit and investment perspectives**

 Sales/collection delays, cost overruns, approval delays, higher financing costs, additional capital requirements and lender recovery analysis.

 Converting detailed models into concise investment/credit committee outputs, dashboards and decision\-making summaries.
* **Model Review \& Controls:** 
 Reconciliations, formula checks, hardcode identification, broken links, timeline checks and model audit.

title: Marine Cargo loss control Specialist surveyors at Mumbai
description:
We’re Hiring \| Marine Loss Control \& Risk Engineering Specialist \| Mumbai
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Marine Loss Control \& Risk Engineering Specialist to strengthen our Marine Cargo Risk Management and Loss Prevention function.
   

 The position requires a professional with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in logistics, cargo handling, marine/transit risk management, loss prevention, root\-cause
   

 analysis and operational gap assessment.
   

  

 The role will focus on proactively identifying why cargo losses occur and how recurrence can be prevented.
   

  

 The specialist will undertake field\-level risk assessments and detailed root\-cause/gap analysis covering exposures such as wet damage, improper handling, shocks \& jolts, inadequate packaging, stowage and stacking failures, compression/load stresses, lashing and securing deficiencies, contamination, cargo characteristics and other logistics\-related causes of loss.
   

  

 A critical part of the role will involve analysing Claims MIS, historical loss trends, survey reports and operational data to identify recurring patterns and loss drivers, correlate field observations with claims experience, and translate the findings into practical and measurable Loss Prevention / Loss Control recommendations for insured clients.
   

  

 The specialist will also support Marine Underwriting by assessing complex or critical cargo exposures prior to risk acceptance, identifying potential loss scenarios and providing technically supported risk insights, warranties, safeguards and loss\-control recommendations to assist underwriting decisions.
   

  

 Preferred Professional Background: Master Mariner / Chief Officer / Second Engineer; or an experienced Engineer / Packaging Specialist with strong practical knowledge of logistics and cargo handling. Candidates from relevant marine, engineering, cargo risk or industrial packaging backgrounds may also be considered where they can demonstrate expertise in packaging design and adequacy, compression/load stresses, palletisation, stacking, stowage planning, lashing, securing and cargo\-handling risk assessment.
   

  

 The successful candidate should demonstrate strong analytical and investigative capability, field presence, technical judgment and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to convert complex observations and loss data into clear gap analyses and actionable recommendations.
   

 The position requires willingness to travel extensively for field risk inspections and client engagements, along with excellent technical report\-writing and presentation skills. Strong proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint is essential for claims analytics, trend analysis and management/client presentations.
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

 Level: Mid\-Senior
   

  

 Experience: Minimum 10 years relevant experience
   

  

 Function: Marine Cargo Risk Management \| Loss Control Engineering \| Loss Prevention \| Risk Engineering
   

 We are looking for a professional who can move beyond conventional inspection and reporting — someone capable of understanding what can go wrong, why losses are occurring, where the control gaps exist, and what engineering interventions can prevent the next loss.

description:

 C\+\+ Development (Senior Manager)
 



**Grade** 
 : Senior Manager
 



**Department**

 : Graduate, Post Graduate
 



**Work Exp** 
 : 10 to 14 years
 



  





**Job Description / Roles \& Responsibilities** 




 The Technical Lead C\+\+ Development (Senior Manager) will act as the core technical authority and delivery anchor for our ultra\-low\-latency engineering pod. This role balances hands\-on, high\-performance C\+\+ systems programming (roughly 60%\-70% of the time) with technical mentorship and agile sprint management (30–40%). The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between high\-level architectural designs and concrete, microsecond\-optimized code implementation.
 



 Core Role Information
 


* Designation: Technical Lead (Senior Manager) – C\+\+ Development
* Department: Technology
* Reporting To: Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Development Head



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Hands\-on Low\-Latency Systems Engineering** 



* Write, optimize, and maintain high\-performance execution engines and market data applications using Modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\).
* Implement deterministic, low\-latency programming paradigms, strictly avoiding runtime heap allocations (malloc/new) on the trading hot\-path through custom memory pools and placement new.
* Develop ultra\-fast Inter\-Process Communication (IPC) frameworks—such as shared memory rings and lock\-free circular queues—to pass data across trading components with sub\-microsecond overhead.
* Design highly concurrent, multi\-threaded workflows, configuring thread affinity (pthread\_setaffinity\_np) and optimizing data layouts to prevent CPU cache thrashing and lock contention.
* Incorporate proprietary template\-based architectures or High\-Level Template (HTL) constructs to shift computational logic to compile\-time.



**2\. Core Data Engineering \& Domain Integration** 



* Apply expert\-level knowledge of Data Structures and Algorithms to engineer optimal custom indexing, sorting, and binary parsing solutions.
* Design and maintain high\-throughput relational tracking databases using MySQL for order logs, risk configurations, and reference data management.
* Leverage trading domain knowledge to translate complex financial logic (such as order routing, compliance checks, risk management parameters, or exchange protocols like FIX, ITCH, or SBE) into concrete technical implementations.



**3\. Technical Leadership \& Code Governance** 



* Lead daily sprint cycles, translate functional specifications into technical tasks, and ensure timely product delivery.
* Enforce absolute code quality via strict peer code reviews, continuous profiling (using tools like Valgrind, gprof, or Perf), and performance regression benchmarking.
* Provide daily technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, establishing standardized coding guidelines for the team.



  





**Job Specific Skills** 



* C\+\+ \& Metaprogramming Expertise: Exceptional mastery of systems\-level C\+\+, including template metaprogramming, RAII, smart pointers, and strict memory safety.
* Concurrency Mastery: Practical experience writing production\-grade, lock\-free, atomic, and multi\-threaded processing pipelines.
* Low\-Latency Infrastructure: Clear understanding of CPU architectures (cache line synchronization, branch predictors) and Linux OS tuning (core isolation, kernel bypass).
* Data Layout \& DB Optimization: Advanced ability to optimize algorithms for hardware cache locality and structure complex database queries, indexes, and schemas in MySQL.
* HTL Frameworks: Experience using template libraries or customized HTL concepts to achieve zero\-overhead abstractions.



  





**Minimum Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative stream.
* Experience: 8\+ years of professional software development experience in systems programming, with at least 3\+ years of experience leading small\-to\-mid\-sized developer teams or pods.
* Domain Advantage: Prior background in High\-Frequency Trading (HFT), investment bank execution desks, derivatives risk systems, or market data feeds is highly desirable.



  





 For more details, contact Archana at Archana.tiwari@tnmhr.com / \+91 9821821884\.

The company delivers high\-quality engineered solutions for complex architectural projects and collaborates with international clients including U.S.\-based project teams.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and driven Installation Project Coordinator to join our team on a full\-time basis. Reporting to the Project Manager, this person takes full ownership of a project the moment fabricated panels and components arrive on the US construction site — managing everything from site readiness through to final handover and punch list closure. This is a remotely coordinated role based in India, requiring strong communication skills, US construction knowledge, and the ability to manage an on\-site installation superintendent, subcontractors, and direct labor crews across multiple concurrent projects. Starting with GFRC and FRP facade systems, this role will expand to cover all installation projects as the business grows.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Site Ownership \& Execution**
* Take full ownership of the project from the moment fabricated panels and materials arrive on the US construction site — this is your handover point and your project from that moment forward
* Manage the complete on\-site installation process through to final handover, including installation superintendent direction, subcontractor coordination, and direct labor crew oversight
* Monitor daily site progress against the installation schedule, identifying issues proactively and resolving them before they impact the critical path
* Ensure site readiness before material arrival — access clearance, equipment mobilization, scaffold setup, embed verification, and safety induction all confirmed in advance
* Track material receipt, unloading, stacking, and storage on site to ensure panels are handled correctly and available when needed
* Coordinate with job site superintendents on quality control gates, budgets, timelines.



  




* **GC \& Stakeholder Communication**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for the General Contractor's Project Manager — maintaining a professional, proactive, and solution\-oriented relationship always
* Attend (remotely) and lead site coordination meetings with the GC, resolving open issues, RFIs, and site conflicts in a timely manner
* Produce and distribute accurate, on\-time progress reports to the GC PM and internal leadership — daily updates where required, weekly summary reports as standard
* Manage all site\-level documentation including daily reports, installation logs, change order records, RFI responses, and inspection records
* Escalate commercial, technical, or schedule issues to the Project Manager with a clear summary and recommended course of action



  




* **Schedule \& Resource Management**
* Work closely with the Project Scheduler to maintain an accurate installation schedule — providing site\-level inputs on progress, constraints, and look\-ahead requirements
* Manage on\-site resource allocation — ensuring the right crew size, equipment, and subcontractor availability is in place at every phase of the installation

title: Human Resources Lead
description:
**Note** 
 : This is an in\-office role based out of Mumbai, 6 days a week. An ideal candidate should have 4\-8 years of experience. Please apply if you meet the above criteria.
 



 HR Lead.
 



  





 Luma is building the future of fertility care in India — patient\-first, tech\-enabled, and unapologetically different from the clinical, impersonal experience that defines the category today. Backed by Peak XV, founded by a second\-time entrepreneur who has built and scaled before, Luma is past the idea stage and into the work of building a real organization around a real mission: better, more human healthcare for women, at scale.
 



 This role builds the people function from the ground up, inside a company trying to change what fertility care looks like in this country.
 



  





**What this role actually is** 




 Someone who can go from zero to one. You’ve built policy from nothing, set up payroll, made hiring work under real pressure. This is a hands\-on operator role — you do the work, not just direct others to do it. You’ll manage a small, growing team of your own.
 



 You’ll also design how the organization runs as it grows: clear roles, KRAs that mean something, a real sense of what good performance looks like at each level, and outcomes tied to the business as Luma expands into new clinics. Managing HR across a lean central team and a distributed, multi\-clinic footprint is core to this role, not an edge case.
 



  





**What you’ll own** 




     •    HR infrastructure — policy, process, and systems built from scratch
 



     •    Payroll and compliance, run cleanly and on time
 



     •    Hiring — sourcing, screening, and closing roles fast, across head office and clinical functions
 



     •    Organization design — role clarity, KRAs, and performance frameworks that hold up as the company scales across multiple clinics
 



     •    Training and learning calendars, including clinical staff training
 



     •    Employee engagement across a central team and a clinic floor with a different operating rhythm
 



     •    Onboarding and the day\-to\-day discipline that keeps a growing, multi\-location team functioning
 



  





**What we’re looking for** 




 Real experience building HR inside an early\-stage, scaling startup, run lean and hands\-on. Healthcare, fertility care or clinic\-floor HR experience is a strong plus and will be prioritized.
 



  





**Why this role matters** 




 Fertility care in India has historically been clinical, transactional, and disempowering for the women going through it. Luma exists to change that — and the team you build, and the culture you set, will shape whether that mission is deliverable at scale. This is the chance to build the people foundation of a category\-defining, women\-led healthcare company early, not join one after the interesting decisions are already made.

title: Growth Marketer
description:
WE'RE HIRING: GROWTH MARKETER 🚀Sampurna Growth Academy (SGA Pvt. Ltd.)
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai / Goregaon West
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Department:** 
 Marketing \& Growth
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 years
 



**Industry:** 
 EdTech \| Education \| Consumer Brands
 



  





 About Us
 



 Sampurna Growth Academy (SGA) is building a new\-age education ecosystem with a mission to empower 1 crore individuals over the next 10 years.
 



 Through our brands, including
 **Chate Prep\+ (CPP)** 
 and
 **The Weekend School (TWS)** 
 , we are creating accessible, outcome\-driven learning experiences for students across India.
 



 We are looking for a Growth Marketer who understands that marketing is not just about running advertisements or generating leads. It is about building a predictable, scalable customer acquisition engine.
 



**Your mission: Turn marketing investments into measurable business growth.** 




  





 1\. Your Role
 



 As a Growth Marketer, you will take ownership of the complete customer acquisition journey, from generating awareness to converting prospects into paying customers.
 



 You will work closely with the founder, creative team, sales team, and operations team to develop and execute growth strategies.
 



 You will be responsible for identifying growth opportunities, running experiments, improving conversion rates, and scaling successful campaigns.
 



 We are looking for someone who can think strategically, execute independently, and make decisions based on data.
 



**This is a hands\-on growth role, not just a campaign management position.** 




  





 2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Performance Marketing \& Customer Acquisition
 


* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Develop customer acquisition strategies for different products, audiences, and geographical markets.
* Manage advertising budgets and allocate spending based on campaign performance.
* Continuously optimize campaigns to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and customer acquisition costs.
* Build and manage remarketing campaigns for website visitors, leads, and abandoned checkouts.
* Experiment with new audiences, advertising formats, messaging, and acquisition channels.
* Identify and scale profitable campaigns while reducing spending on underperforming campaigns.



**Expected outcome:** 
 Consistent acquisition of qualified leads and paying customers at sustainable acquisition costs.
 



  





 B. Funnel Development \& Conversion Rate Optimization
 



 Own the complete customer journey:
 



**Ad → Landing Page → Lead → CRM → Sales → Payment → Customer** 




 Your responsibilities include:
 


* Design and optimize marketing funnels for different products.
* Work with the website team to create high\-converting landing pages.
* Identify where potential customers drop off during the purchase journey.
* Run A/B tests on advertising creatives, landing pages, headlines, offers, and calls to action.
* Improve lead\-to\-sale and website\-to\-purchase conversion rates.
* Develop lead nurturing and remarketing strategies.
* Optimize checkout journeys to reduce abandoned purchases.
* Work closely with the sales team to understand customer objections and improve marketing communication.



 C. Marketing Analytics \& Reporting
 



 You will be responsible for maintaining complete visibility into marketing performance.
 



 Track and report the following metrics:
 



 MetricWhat You Will TrackAd SpendDaily and monthly marketing expenditureLeads GeneratedTotal leads across campaignsCost Per Lead (CPL)Acquisition cost per leadQualified LeadsLeads meeting defined qualification criteriaLead\-to\-Sale ConversionPercentage of leads becoming customersCustomer Acquisition Cost (CAC)Total acquisition cost per paying customerRevenue GeneratedRevenue attributed to marketing campaignsReturn on Ad Spend (ROAS)Revenue generated relative to advertising expenditureFunnel ConversionConversion rates across customer journey stages
 



**Daily reporting is mandatory.** 




 You should be able to explain where money was spent, what results it generated, which campaigns performed well, and what needs improvement.
 



 Reports must translate data into clear, actionable business decisions.
 



  





 D. Creative Strategy \& Content Marketing
 


* Work closely with designers, video editors, and content creators to develop high\-performing advertising creatives.
* Research customer motivations, pain points, buying triggers, and objections.
* Develop creative briefs for static advertisements, video advertisements, reels, and landing pages.
* Write or guide the development of persuasive advertising copy, hooks, headlines, and calls to action.
* Test multiple creative concepts and identify the messaging that resonates with different audiences.
* Analyze competitor campaigns and identify opportunities for differentiation.
* Continuously refresh creatives to maintain campaign performance.



 You are not expected to personally design every creative, but you must understand what makes an advertisement convert.
 



  





 E. CRM, Automation \& Lead Nurturing
 


* Work with the sales and CRM teams to ensure every lead is captured, assigned, and followed up.
* Build automated lead nurturing journeys using WhatsApp, email, and other relevant channels.
* Segment leads based on their interests, behaviour, and purchase readiness.
* Develop re\-engagement campaigns for inactive leads.
* Monitor lead response times and follow\-up effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to improve lead\-to\-customer conversion.
* Ensure accurate tracking of customer acquisition sources.



 F. Growth Experiments \& New Opportunities
 


* Identify and test new customer acquisition channels.
* Develop referral, affiliate, partnership, and organic growth initiatives.
* Experiment with new offers, pricing communication, and promotional strategies.
* Research customer behaviour and market opportunities.
* Build repeatable growth systems that can scale across different products and markets.



 You should consistently bring new ideas to the table, test them, measure their performance, and scale what works.
 



  





 3\. What We Expect You to Achieve
 



 Your success will be measured by business outcomes, not simply marketing activity.
 



**First 30 Days: Understand, Audit \& Establish** 



* Understand our products, customers, pricing, and sales process.
* Audit existing marketing campaigns and customer acquisition funnels.
* Establish accurate tracking for advertising expenditure, leads, conversions, and revenue.
* Identify immediate opportunities to improve campaign performance.
* Implement a daily marketing performance dashboard.



**Days 31–60: Optimize \& Experiment** 



* Improve lead quality and customer acquisition efficiency.
* Launch structured creative and audience experiments.
* Optimize landing pages and lead nurturing journeys.
* Identify the most effective customer acquisition channels.
* Establish a repeatable campaign optimization process.



**Days 61–90: Scale \& Build** 



* Scale campaigns demonstrating sustainable acquisition economics.
* Build predictable customer acquisition funnels.
* Develop growth strategies for new products and markets.
* Establish a structured marketing experimentation framework.
* Present a clear growth roadmap for the next quarter.



 Specific revenue, CAC, and acquisition targets will be established based on product economics, available budgets, and historical performance.
 



  





 4\. Who We're Looking ForRequired Skills \& Experience
 


* 2–5 years of experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, or customer acquisition.
* Demonstrated experience managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns.
* Strong understanding of marketing funnels, conversion optimization, and customer acquisition economics.
* Experience working with landing pages, CRM systems, and marketing automation tools.
* Ability to analyze campaign data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Strong copywriting and creative strategy skills.
* Experience managing advertising budgets and optimizing campaigns for measurable business outcomes.
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and execution skills.



 Preferred Experience
 


* Experience in EdTech, education, D2C, or other consumer\-facing businesses.
* Experience with Shopify and online payment funnels.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and conversion tracking.
* Experience using WhatsApp marketing and CRM automation.
* Understanding of regional marketing and Marathi\-speaking audiences.
* Experience scaling campaigns across multiple products or geographical markets.



 5\. The Mindset We Value
 



 We are looking for someone who:
 



**Thinks like a business owner.** 
 Understands that marketing success is measured by customer acquisition, revenue, and sustainable growth.
 



**Takes complete ownership.** 
 Does not wait for instructions to identify problems or improve campaign performance.
 



**Is data\-driven.** 
 Makes decisions based on evidence, experiments, and customer behaviour rather than assumptions.
 



**Moves fast.** 
 Can execute campaigns, test ideas, and implement improvements without unnecessary delays.
 



**Understands customers.** 
 Can translate customer motivations, concerns, and aspirations into compelling marketing communication.
 



**Is comfortable with accountability.** 
 Can clearly explain campaign performance, acknowledge what is not working, and recommend corrective actions.
 



  





 6\. What Makes This Opportunity Different?
 



 You will work directly with the founder and play an important role in building the growth engine of an expanding education business.
 



 This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of marketing strategy, experiment with new ideas, influence product growth, and build scalable customer acquisition systems.
 



 You will have the opportunity to work across multiple education products, customer segments, and markets.
 



 We value initiative, independent thinking, measurable results, and the ability to turn ideas into execution.

 Location: Cocoma Digital HQ – Andheri West, Mumbai
 





 Employment Type: Full\-Time \| On\-site
 





 Experience Required: 2–5 Years
 





 Reporting To: Head of Growth / Performance Marketing Lead

 Cocoma Digital \& Studios is a growing creative and marketing company managing multiple brands and businesses. Our Digital division focuses on YouTube, social media, performance marketing, content, creator collaborations, and digital brand building, while our Studios division provides end\-to\-end post\-production for films, TV, OTT, web series, and social content. We create engaging content and performance\-driven digital solutions that build communities and deliver measurable growth.
 




  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 We are looking for a
 **Performance Marketing Specialist** 
 to manage and scale paid media campaigns across client accounts. The role focuses on
 **Google Ads, YouTube Ads, Meta/Instagram Ads, and Lead Generation** 
 , including campaign setup, targeting, budgets, tracking, optimisation, and reporting.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong
 **platform expertise, analytical thinking, and commercial understanding** 
 to drive qualified leads, conversions, and measurable client growth.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 





 1\. Lead Generation \& Conversion
 



* Plan, build, launch, and optimise lead generation campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Manage lead\-generation campaigns from audience targeting and creative selection through to lead capture and conversion.
* Generate high\-quality and relevant leads, with focus on lead quality rather than volume alone.

* Optimise Meta Lead Forms, landing\-page campaigns, calls, messages, and other conversion pathways.
* Monitor Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), conversion rate, and lead quality.
* Work with client and internal teams to understand lead quality and improve campaign targeting and performance.
* Identify funnel drop\-offs and recommend improvements across creatives, targeting, forms, landing pages, and conversion journeys.
* Ensure campaign\-generated leads are properly captured, tracked, and reported.




 2\. Google Ads \& YouTube Advertising
 



* Build, launch, manage, and optimise campaigns through Google Ads and YouTube Ads.
* Manage audience targeting, geographical targeting, placements, bidding, budgets, and campaign objectives.
* Understand different YouTube advertising formats and campaign structures.
* Monitor campaign performance across views, clicks, engagement, conversions, and cost metrics.
* Optimise campaigns based on CPV, CPM, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversions, and campaign objectives.
* Coordinate with creative and content teams to ensure video assets are suitable for paid amplification.
* Understand the relationship between organic YouTube content performance and paid video campaigns.




 3\. Meta Ads \& Instagram Advertising
 



* Build, launch, manage, and optimise campaigns through Meta Ads Manager for Facebook and Instagram.
* Manage campaigns across objectives including awareness, traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversions.
* Set up and optimise Meta Lead Generation campaigns and lead forms.
* Manage Custom Audiences, Lookalike Audiences, retargeting, geographical targeting, and demographic targeting.
* Optimise Reels, Feed, Stories, and other relevant placements.
* Monitor creative\-level performance and identify high\-performing audiences, formats, messaging, and creatives.
* Work closely with the creative and social media teams to continuously improve campaign performance.




 4\. Campaign Execution \& Account Management
 



* Manage multiple paid\-media accounts simultaneously across different clients, industries, audiences, and budgets.
* Build campaigns according to documented client requirements, objectives, geography, demographics, audience profiles, and budgets.
* Handle campaign setup, targeting, tracking, launch, monitoring, optimisation, and closure.
* Conduct regular account health checks to identify performance issues and opportunities.
* Ensure campaigns are launched accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Maintain proper documentation of campaign structures, budgets, audiences, creatives, and performance.




 5\. Budget Management \& Optimisation
 



* Monitor daily ad spend across multiple client accounts.
* Ensure campaign budgets are paced correctly against approved monthly or campaign\-level spends.
* Adjust bids, budgets, targeting, placements, and campaign structures based on performance.
* Reallocate budgets towards better\-performing campaigns, audiences, creatives, and objectives.
* Identify inefficient spending and take corrective action quickly.
* Optimise towards business\-relevant metrics rather than vanity metrics.
* Maintain focus on CPL, CPA, CPV, CTR, CPC, ROAS, conversion rate, and ROI depending on campaign objectives.




 6\. Analytics, Reporting \& Insights
 



* Monitor and analyse campaign performance across Google Ads, YouTube, Meta, Instagram, and relevant analytics platforms.
* Track metrics including CTR, CPM, CPC, CPV, CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, Average View Duration, retention, organic vs. paid reach, and lead quality.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports for internal and client\-facing use.
* Analyse traffic sources and identify what is driving performance.
* Translate campaign data into clear and actionable insights.
* Identify trends, performance gaps, and optimisation opportunities.
* Connect campaign performance with business outcomes wherever conversion data is available.




 7\. A/B Testing \& Creative Optimisation
 



* Plan and execute A/B tests across audiences, creatives, copy, headlines, thumbnails, CTAs, lead forms, and landing pages.
* Test different hooks, messaging, formats, and creative approaches.
* Identify high\-performing creative concepts and recommend scaling opportunities.
* Work with the creative team to develop new variations based on campaign insights.
* Continuously test and optimise campaigns rather than relying on a single audience or creative.




 8\. YouTube SEO \& Organic Performance
 



* Support YouTube content performance through optimisation of titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, keywords, and other relevant metadata.
* Work with YouTube Studio and channel\-level performance metrics.
* Analyse organic content performance before recommending paid amplification.
* Coordinate with the YouTube and content teams to ensure paid and organic strategies complement each other.
* Understand the relationship between content packaging, audience behaviour, retention, and paid performance.



  





**REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in Performance Marketing / Paid Media.

**Marketing \& Brand Manager** 




**About Surreal** 





 Surreal creates experiences designed to be remembered — from large\-scale installations and seasonal environments
 





 to brand activations, entertainment experiences and public spaces.
 





 Alongside our client work, we're also building our own experiences and IPs, including World of Christmas, as platforms
 





 with the potential to grow into larger consumer\-facing brands.
 





 We're looking for someone to help shape how Surreal — and the brands we create — show up in the world.
 




**The Role** 





 We're looking for a Marketing \& Brand Manager to own and grow Surreal's brand, content and communications, while
 





 also driving the marketing of Surreal's own IPs and experiences.
 





 You'll work closely with leadership, business development, design and project teams to turn what we create into
 





 compelling stories — and make sure those stories reach the right clients, collaborators and audiences.
 





 For our IPs, you'll help translate the experience itself into a brand people want to discover, engage with and return to.
 





 This role sits between brand thinking, commercial thinking and hands\-on execution.
 




  





**What you'll be doing** 





  Develop and drive Surreal's overall marketing and communications strategy and calendar.
 





  Shape and maintain a strong, consistent Surreal brand across all channels.
 





  Own content across LinkedIn, Instagram, the website and other relevant platforms.
 





  Turn completed projects into compelling case studies and stories — from concept and making through to the final experience.
 





  Work with project teams to identify and capture the right content during design, fabrication and installation.
 





  Coordinate photographers, videographers, designers, agencies and other creative partners.
 





  Manage and continually develop Surreal's website and project portfolio.
 





  Develop credentials, presentations, case studies and market\-specific collateral alongside Business Development.
 





  Identify and manage relevant PR, editorial, award and industry opportunities.
 





  Support exhibitions, international fairs, launches and major company announcements.
 





  Develop and execute marketing strategies for Surreal\-owned IPs, including World of Christmas.
 





  Build seasonal campaign calendars across digital, social, PR and on\-ground touchpoints for Surreal IPs.
 





  Drive audience awareness, engagement and growth for the IPs.
 





  Support ticketing/e\-commerce, partnerships, sponsorships and other commercial initiatives from a marketing perspective.
 





  Coordinate IP content, shoots, campaigns, creators/influencers, PR and external agencies.
 





  Use performance insights to improve future campaigns, audience growth and brand development.
 





  Help build Surreal's IPs as brands in their own right, not simply individual events.
 




  





**What we're looking for** 





  5–8 years' experience across brand, marketing, communications or related creative roles.
 





  Experience within experiential, creative/design, architecture, entertainment, lifestyle, retail or another visually driven business is strongly preferred.
 





  Experience working across both B2B and consumer\-facing brands would be a strong advantage.
 





  Strong understanding of brand positioning, visual storytelling and integrated campaigns.
 





  Excellent writing and communication skills.
 





  Strong visual judgement and an eye for good creative work.
 





  Experience managing content, social media, websites and external creative partners.
 





  Ability to turn complex creative projects into simple, engaging stories.
 





  Strong project\-management skills and ability to take ideas from strategy through execution.
 





  Comfortable working across multiple brands, campaigns and priorities.
 





  Curious, proactive and genuinely interested in design, culture, experiences and consumer behaviour.This is not a purely digital/performance marketing role. We're looking for someone who understands how brands are
 





 built — and is equally comfortable developing the thinking and making sure it gets executed.
 




  





**In short:** 

 you make sure the work we create becomes the brand people know Surreal for — and that the experiences
 





 we own become brands people actively want to be part of.
 




  





**Ideal candidate profile** 





  5–8 years' experience with meaningful ownership of brand, content or communications.
 





  Understands creative work, visual storytelling and how to build narratives around physical experiences/projects.
 





  Can work across B2B corporate/studio marketing and B2C audience marketing.
 





  Has created campaigns, case studies, websites/content, PR or award submissions rather than only managing media budgets.
 





  Strong enough visually to brief and judge photography, film, design and social content.
 





  Comfortable managing agencies/freelancers while remaining hands\-on.
 





  Commercially aware enough to connect brand activity with audience growth, ticketing/e\-commerce, partnerships and sponsorships for IPs.
 





  Proactive about spotting stories and content opportunities during the making of a project, not only after completion.
 




  





**Priority talent pools** 





  Experiential / brand experience / creative agencies.

**What we're looking for** 



* 3 to 5 years writing in an advertising agency or an in\-house brand team.

title: Content & UI Specialist
description:
Job Type: Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 Job Category: IT
   

  

**Job Description**
 Are you ready to grow your career in our global tech hub?
   

  

 Zurich Cover\-More Group helps people travel safely across the globe every day. We are there at every step of a traveller’s journey, to keep them safe and help them out if something goes wrong. We are committed to providing reliable, fast, flexible and bespoke services for our customers as well as the many well\-known brands we partner with, such as travel agencies, airlines, banks and major sporting clubs!

**So, what’s the job?**
* You'll proactively partner with stakeholders to develop, manage, and maintain digital content across CMS platforms, ensuring quality, accuracy, and consistency at every stage.
* You'll lead the creation and management of pages supporting product, feature, and campaign launches.
* You'll establish, advocate for, and enforce content standards and best practices across CMS platforms.
* You'll manage site authors by overseeing access permissions, governance processes, and CMS training initiatives.
* You'll conduct regular site audits to identify broken links, outdated content, and UX issues while driving continuous content improvements.
* You'll optimise web pages for usability, accessibility, and search engine optimisation (SEO).
* You'll collaborate with UX/UI designers across multiple geographies and time zones to implement intuitive interfaces, improve user journeys, and enhance overall site usability.
* You'll partner with developers, product teams, and global stakeholders to translate business requirements into polished, user\-friendly digital experiences.
* You'll design and implement features and workflows that improve efficiency in content management processes.
* You'll ensure all digital experiences meet responsive design, device and browser compatibility, and WCAG/ADA accessibility standards.
* You'll build feasibility analyses and proof\-of\-concept (POC) solutions for optimisation initiatives using ZCM's standard CMS component set.
* You'll plan, build, and execute A/B and multivariate tests using ZCM's test\-and\-learn toolset.
* You'll validate optimisation rules and audience segment configurations to ensure accurate test delivery.
* You'll analyse test results and convert insights into actionable recommendations, effectively communicating outcomes to stakeholders across locations.
* You'll lead UAT and QA processes to ensure accurate, high\-performing, and compliant digital experiences across web and app touchpoints.
* You'll validate content, functionality, device responsiveness, and WCAG compliance across partner and owned digital properties.
* You'll coordinate QA activities across distributed teams to ensure comprehensive testing and smooth go\-live execution.
* You'll act as the subject\-matter expert on ZCM's CMS, optimisation toolset, and digital platforms, providing first\-level support to the Rapid Learning Lab team globally.
* You'll document requirements for CMS component enhancements and communicate effectively with developers and stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* You'll demonstrate strong asynchronous communication practices, keeping remote and onshore stakeholders informed, engaged, and unblocked between scheduled touchpoints.
* You'll work closely with Content, UX Design, Engineering, and broader business teams to deliver cohesive, high\-quality digital outcomes.
* You'll align Rapid Learning Lab and travel partner requirements to maximise technology capabilities, optimise user experiences, and drive sales performance.
* You'll write and debug CSS to create high\-quality web experiences, including resolving specificity and cascade conflicts, leveraging CSS custom properties, and translating design mockups into responsive, production\-ready web pages.
* You'll apply modern CSS layout techniques, including Flexbox and CSS Grid, to build responsive interfaces that provide an optimal experience across devices and screen sizes.
* You'll use browser Developer Tools to inspect, troubleshoot, and resolve styling, layout, and markup issues in live environments.
* You'll utilise vanilla JavaScript for DOM manipulation, including element selection, content updates, class management, and basic interactive functionality.
* You'll create, update, and manage website content using Web Content Management Systems (CMS), ensuring accurate and engaging digital experiences.
* You'll build and manage A/B and multivariate tests on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) websites using Adobe Target and similar experimentation platforms to optimise user experience and business outcomes.
* You'll apply front\-end development skills to implement, customise, and support website enhancements, experiments, and digital initiatives.
* You'll maintain a strong understanding of website architecture, functionality, and best practices to support effective digital delivery.
* You'll ensure websites meet WCAG and ADA accessibility standards by identifying, addressing, and preventing common accessibility issues.
* You'll apply SEO best practices, ensuring websites are optimised for search engine visibility, performance, and discoverability.
* You'll design and develop responsive web experiences that follow industry best practices and deliver consistent functionality across a range of devices and screen sizes.
* You'll implement and validate web analytics and advertising tracking tags using tools such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, and related marketing technologies to support measurement and optimisation activities.
* You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure tracking, experimentation, accessibility, SEO, and front\-end development requirements are effectively delivered and maintained.


**And what are we looking for?**
* You'll bring a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Digital Marketing, Web Design, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field.
* You'll have 18 months or more of hands\-on, business\-side experience managing content within a CMS for a public\-facing website.
* You'll demonstrate experience working within offshore, distributed, or globally dispersed teams, successfully managing deliverables and communications across multiple time zones.
* You'll have hands\-on experience with one or more enterprise CMS platforms, such as Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Tridion, or Ektron.
* You'll possess experience using multivariate and A/B testing tools and methodologies, including platforms such as Adobe Target, Optimizely, Google Optimize, or similar solutions.
* You'll have a solid technical understanding of HTML, CSS, and web publishing principles.
* You'll demonstrate a strong understanding of content optimisation, technical SEO principles, and digital best practices.
* You'll have proven experience creating and managing web pages designed for a global audience.
* You'll possess strong knowledge of responsive design, device and browser compatibility, and WCAG/ADA accessibility standards.
* You'll have experience leading or supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Quality Assurance (QA) processes for digital products.
* You'll stand out with experience using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
* You'll bring knowledge of additional Adobe Digital Marketing tools, such as Adobe Target and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics.
* You'll have familiarity with digital environments within the travel or insurance industries.
* You'll have exposure to analytics and reporting tools that support optimisation and test performance analysis.
* You'll be exceptionally detail\-oriented, with outstanding proofreading skills and a commitment to content accuracy and test quality.
* You'll be a clear and proactive communicator who keeps remote and onshore stakeholders informed, aligned, and engaged.
* You'll work confidently and independently, managing priorities across multiple time zones with minimal day\-to\-day supervision.
* You'll thrive in a fast\-paced environment, seamlessly switching between priorities while consistently meeting deadlines without compromising quality.
* You'll be self\-motivated, responsive, and committed to delivering high\-quality digital experiences regardless of team location.
* You'll be highly collaborative and team\-oriented, recognising that exceptional digital experiences are built through strong global partnerships.
* You'll be naturally curious and improvement\-focused, constantly seeking opportunities to enhance digital experiences and outcomes.


**So, why choose us?**
 We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability and determination.
   

  

 We have more than 2600 employees worldwide: we’re a global group of digital natives, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts and customer service professionals. We share a global mission to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.
   

  

 Job flexibility. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid work week policy ensures our employees maintain work\-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.
   

  

 Career growth. We want you to continue to learn, develop and bring your ideas to the table. We want to hear what you think, and we want you to work with the business \- not for the business!
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. So whatever walk of life you wander, just be you and come as you are.
   

  

 Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need, when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, covid leave (to get vaccinated and for when you’re sick), volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.
   

  

**We also offer some other perks including:**
* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency

* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays

****This is a full\-time, work\-from\-office role with a required work\-from\-office presence five days a week.****
**Location:** 
 Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (100% Onsite)
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a proactive Datacenter Operations Engineer with a strong background in operating systems, command\-line management, and mobile/tablet infrastructure. In this role, you will support our Navi Mumbai datacenter and test lab infrastructure, with a primary focus on maintaining Linux, macOS, and mobile device fleets (Android \& iOS) deployed in the environment.
   

  

 Unlike traditional datacenter roles centered on server component replacement, this position heavily emphasizes OS\-level troubleshooting, device provisioning, command\-line operations, network connectivity, and mobile endpoint lifecycle management. You will work onsite in Navi Mumbai while collaborating closely with global engineering teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Linux, macOS \& Mobile Infrastructure Management
* Deploy, configure, monitor, and maintain local Linux and macOS endpoints, server environments, and test rigs using command\-line interface (CLI) utilities.
* Manage, provision, and troubleshoot onsite mobile hardware fleets (Android smartphones, tablets, iPads, and iOS test platforms).
* Perform device onboarding, OS flashing/updates, configuration resets, and script\-driven automated deployments across mobile and desktop platforms.
* Diagnose OS\-level connectivity, permission, software installation, and performance issues on mobile devices and workstations.
* Datacenter Operations \& Networking
* Manage physical rack infrastructure, including cabling (copper/fiber), Wi\-Fi Access Points (APs), and Power Distribution Units (PDUs).
* Perform daily environment inspections, monitoring rack temperatures, power draw, Wi\-Fi signal/AP status, and physical port links.
* Maintain structured inventory and tracking for all endpoint hardware, mobile devices, tablets, test bench rigs, and networking gear using asset tagging systems.
* Incident Management \& Documentation
* Track, manage, and resolve Level 2 technical support tickets end\-to\-end within Jira, ensuring compliance with operational SLAs.
* Create and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), system build guides, and infrastructure workflows in Confluence.
* Collaborate with global, cross\-functional engineering teams to escalate platform\-level software/network issues and implement fixes.
* Secondary / As\-Needed Hardware Support
* Provide occasional, low\-frequency assistance with standard rack\-mount hardware rack/stack and basic cabling (heavy server component break\-fix is minimal for this role).
* Escort and supervise external vendors for third\-party facility, ISP, or hardware maintenance.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* Core Requirements
* Communication: Business\-level fluency in spoken and written English, with the ability to clearly articulate technical issues, write concise Jira updates, and collaborate seamlessly with global remote teams.
* Experience: 2–4 years in IT operations, systems administration, or specialized datacenter/lab support roles.
* Operating Systems \& CLI: Strong hands\-on proficiency with Linux (Ubuntu/RHEL/Debian) and macOS, with proven ability to navigate systems, troubleshoot issues, and execute tasks efficiently via Command Line Interface (CLI).
* Mobile Hardware \& Management: Demonstrable experience managing and troubleshooting Android and iOS mobile devices/tablets at scale in an enterprise, testing, or lab setting.
* Networking Basics: Solid understanding of IP networking, TCP/IP, VLANs, Wi\-Fi AP placement/troubleshooting, switching, and physical connectivity.
* Tools \& Process: Direct operational experience using Jira for ticket lifecycle tracking and Confluence for technical documentation.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical troubleshooting skills with a proactive approach to resolving OS and infrastructure issues.
* Preferred / "Nice\-to\-Have" Skills
* Hands\-on scripting experience in Bash, Python, or configuration automation toolsets (e.g., Ansible) for device/system tasks.
* Experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM) software (e.g., Jamf, Workspace ONE, Intune).
* Familiarity with enterprise productivity suites like Google Workspace.


**Work Environment \& Physical Demands**
* 100% Onsite: Requires daily on\-premise presence at the Navi Mumbai facility.
* Physical Ability: Comfortable working with rack\-mounted equipment, mobile testing racks, and routine physical cable routing.


**Benefits**
 In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:
   

  

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents\-in\-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual \& Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life\-event leaves
* Remote\-First work environment that allows our people to work from home
* Remote\-First Allowance for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co\-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience

title: Data Center Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai, India (onsite)
 



**Type:** 
 Permanent
 



**Experience:** 
 10 plus years in data centre / infrastructure engineering (trading/HFT experience strongly preferred)
 



  





 About the role
 



 Own the physical and logical infrastructure that powers ultra\-low\-latency trading systems. You'll design, deploy and maintain rack layouts, structured cabling, servers and network hardware across primary data centres and colocation sites—working closely with network, systems and trading\-technology teams.
 



 This is a hands\-on role where clean builds, precise documentation and fast, safe changes directly impact trading performance and resilience.
 



  





 What you'll do
 


* Design and implement low\-latency data centre infrastructure: rack layouts, power, cooling, cable paths and connectivity plans.
* Perform rack\-and\-stack of servers, switches, trading appliances and specialist hardware; manage asset lifecycles.
* Install, test and maintain structured cabling (fibre and copper): LC/MPO/MTP, patch panels, transceivers, SFPs/QSFPs.
* Configure and support high\-speed network hardware (10/25/40/100GbE\+) from vendors such as Arista, Cisco, Juniper, Mellanox/NVIDIA.
* Work with Linux server hardware and remote management (iLO, iDRAC, IPMI); perform firmware/BIOS/BMC updates and hardware diagnostics.



  





 What we're looking for
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics/Telecommunications or related field (or equivalent hands\-on experience).
* Hands\-on data centre experience in latency\-sensitive environments (trading/HFT, exchanges, financial infrastructure).
* Strong knowledge of data centre design: power distribution, redundancy, rack capacity, environmental considerations and best practices.
* Proven experience with structured cabling: fibre (LC, MPO, MTP) and copper (Cat6/Cat6a), cable dressing and management.
* Practical experience deploying and supporting servers, switches and network appliances in production.



  





 Nice to have
 


* Exposure to low\-latency trading infrastructure: kernel\-bypass NICs, FPGA/SmartNIC appliances, PTP/NTP timing.
* Experience with colocation projects across APAC exchanges and data centres.
* Scripting/automation for provisioning or validation (Python, Bash, Ansible).
* Vendor certifications (Arista, Cisco, Juniper) or data centre design credentials.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Infiniband and Networking Ethernet - NVIS
description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Networking (ETH/IB) Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyze, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Primary responsibilities will include building AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers.
* Support operational and reliability aspects of large\-scale AI clusters, focusing on performance at scale, real\-time monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement.
* Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency, and overall system health.
* Provide feedback to internal teams such as opening bugs, documenting workarounds, and suggesting improvements.


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields.
* At least 5\+ years of professional experience in networking fundamentals, Ethernet or InfiniBand World.
* Hands\-on experience with network switch/router platforms like Cumulus Linux, SONiC, IOS, JunosOS, and EOS, etc.
* Possess solid working knowledge of Ethernet/InfiniBand/RDMA core principles.
* Be proficient in end\-to\-end IB/Eth cluster deployment, adapter configuration and firmware maintenance, and able to conduct professional performance benchmarking with mainstream RDMA testing tools.
* Capable of independently diagnosing and troubleshooting typical IB/Eth network anomalies, including link flapping, connection failure, as well as bandwidth and latency jitter issues.
* Master practical RDMA network optimization strategies such as QP tuning, MTU configuration and congestion control optimization.
* Hands\-on working experience in RDMA\-accelerated business scenarios, including distributed storage and high\-performance computing clusters.
* Extensive experience delivering automated network provisioning solutions using tools like Ansible, Salt, and Python.
* Ability to develop CI/CD pipelines for network operations.
* Strong written, verbal, and listening skills in English are essential.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Advanced Linux or Networking Certifications.
* Experience with High\-performance computing architectures. Understanding of how job schedulers(Slurm, PBS) work.
* luster management technologies knowledge (bonus credit for BCM (Base Command Manager).)
* Experience with GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) focused hardware/software.

**AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Manager to act as the technical owner for client\-facing network \& Infrastructure Security transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands\-on manager who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models).
   

  

 This role is part of the Cyber Frontier \& AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI\-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443\-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Oversee deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE,DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Lead incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Provide strategic guidance on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Design and implement AI\-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Develop and deploy AI\-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI\-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI\-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero\-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI\-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across AI driven Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Experience with OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* Expertise in XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.

* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery

description:
**Company Description** 
 Founded in the UK in 1981, Dunbar \& Boardman (D\&B) is an independent specialist consultancy providing Vertical Transportation and Façade Access advisory services across the UK, Middle East, India, and international markets. With over four decades of experience, D\&B supports clients through the full building lifecycle, from feasibility and concept design to commissioning and long\-term asset management. The firm’s services span lift, escalator, and moving\-walkway planning, traffic analysis, performance\-based design, technical specifications, and maintenance management. Façade Access consultancy includes strategies and systems for safe, efficient building maintenance, integrating operational and safety requirements from early design stages. As a manufacturer\-neutral consultancy, D\&B focuses on project performance, safety, lifecycle value, and client interests to help create future\-ready, maintainable buildings.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time Graduate Engineering Trainee role is based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region with a hybrid working arrangement, combining office\-based collaboration with some work\-from\-home flexibility. The trainee will support senior engineers in delivering Vertical Transportation and Façade Access consulting services, including assisting with technical calculations, design reviews, and preparation of reports and presentations. Daily responsibilities will involve data collection and analysis, contributing to feasibility studies, helping develop technical specifications, and supporting project documentation and coordination. The role includes collaborating with internal teams and external stakeholders, attending project meetings, and learning to apply relevant standards and regulations to engineering solutions. The trainee will receive structured guidance to develop professional skills in consulting, engineering analysis, and project delivery within a specialist building services environment.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Mechanical Engineering knowledge, ideally with exposure to building services or related disciplines.
* Candidates should possess Manufacturing Engineering or similar applied engineering skills relevant to design, planning, or technical analysis.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills, including comfort with data analysis, calculations, and problem\-solving in technical contexts.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills for preparing clear reports, documentation, and engaging with project stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess foundational Project Management abilities, such as organizing tasks, managing timelines, and supporting coordinated project delivery.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field are expected.
* Proficiency with standard office software and basic engineering tools; familiarity with CAD or simulation software is an advantage.
* Attention to detail, willingness to learn, and the ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary, international consulting environment.
